14.25.12: manasā gamyate yacca yacca vācā nigadyate,
śrotreṇa śrūyate yacca cakṣuṣā yacca dr̥śyate ॥12॥
14.25.13: sparśena spr̥śyate yacca ghrāṇena ghrāyate ca yat,
14.25.17: devaṁ nārāyaṇaṁ bhīru sarvātmānaṁ nibodha tam ॥17॥
14.25.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi brāhmaṇagītāsu pañcaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥25॥
14.26.8: omityekākṣaraṁ brahma te śrutvā prādravan diśaḥ ॥8॥
14.26.9: sarpāṇāṁ daṁśane bhāvaḥ pravr̥ttaḥ pūrvameva tu ॥9॥
14.26.13: tasya cānumate karma tataḥ paścāt pravartate,
gururboddhā ca śrotā ca dveṣṭā ca hr̥di niḥsr̥taḥ ॥13॥
14.26.15: kāmacārī tu kāmena ya indriyasukhe rataḥ,
14.26.17: āpo brahma gururbrahma sa brahmaṇi samāhitaḥ ॥17॥
14.26.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi brāhmaṇagītāsu ṣaḍviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥26॥
14.27.3: kva tad vanaṁ mahāprājña ke vr̥kṣāḥ saritaśca kāḥ,
14.27.5: tasmād hrasvataraṁ nāsti na tato’sti mahattaram,
nāsti tasmāt sūkṣmataraṁ nāstyanyat tatsamaṁ sukham ॥5॥
14.27.6: na tatrāviśya śocanti na prahr̥ṣyanti ca dvijāḥ,
na ca bibhyati keṣāñcit tebhyo bibhyati kecana ॥6॥
14.27.8: pañcavarṇāni divyāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca,
sr̥jantaḥ pādapāstatra vyāpya tiṣṭhanti tad vanam ॥8॥
14.27.9: suvarṇāni dvivarṇāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca,
sr̥jantaḥ pādapāstatra vyāpya tiṣṭhanti tad vanam ॥9॥
14.27.10: surabhīṇi dvivarṇāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca,
sr̥jantaḥ pādapāstatra vyāpya tiṣṭhanti tad vanam ॥10॥
14.27.11: sr̥jantaḥ pādapāstatra vyāpya tiṣṭhanti tad vanam ॥11॥
14.27.12: visr̥jantau mahāvr̥kṣau tad vanaṁ vyāpya tiṣṭhataḥ ॥12॥
14.27.16: ye’dhigacchanti taṁ santasteṣāṁ nāsti bhayaṁ punaḥ,
ūrdhvaṁ cādhaśca tiryak ca tasya nānto’dhigamyate ॥16॥
14.27.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi brāhmaṇagītāsu saptaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥27॥
14.28.1: gandhān na jighrāmi rasān na vedmi
rūpaṁ na paśyāmi na ca spr̥śāmi,
14.28.9: yo hyasya pārthivo bhāgaḥ pr̥thivīṁ sa gamiṣyati,
14.28.10: sūryaṁ cakṣurdiśaḥ śrītraṁ prāṇo’sya divameva ca,
āgame vartamānasya na me doṣo’sti kaścana ॥10॥
14.28.11: chāgārthe vartate yajño bhavataḥ kiṁ prayojanam ॥11॥
14.28.12: atra tvāṁ manyatāṁ bhrātā pitā mātā sakheti ca,
14.28.14: śarīraṁ kevalaṁ śiṣṭaṁ niśceṣṭamiti me matiḥ ॥14॥
14.28.16: yadihiṁsraṁ bhavet karma tat kāryamiti vidmahe ॥16॥
14.28.20: sarvāṇyetāni bhūtāni prāṇā iti ca manyase ॥20॥
14.28.21: nāsti ceṣṭā vinā hiṁsāṁ kiṁ vā tvaṁ manyase dvija ॥21॥
14.28.22: akṣaraṁ tatra sadbhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ kṣara ucyate ॥22॥
14.28.23: prāṇo jihvā manaḥ sattvaṁ sadbhāvo rajasā saha,
14.28.24: samantāt parimuktasya na bhayaṁ vidyate kvacit ॥24॥
14.28.25: bhavato hi mataṁ śrutvā pratibhāti matirmama ॥25॥
14.28.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi brāhmaṇagītāsu aṣṭāviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥28॥
14.29.4: mā muñca vīra nārācān brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te ॥4॥
14.29.6: vidyate taṁ samācakṣva yaḥ samāsīta māṁ mr̥dhe ॥6॥
14.29.8: tataḥ sa rājā prayayau krodhena mahatā vr̥taḥ,
14.29.12: taṁ hataṁ patitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sametāḥ sarvabāndhavāḥ,
14.29.16: evaṁ te draviḍā’’bhīrāḥ puṇḍrāśca śabaraiḥ saha,
14.29.19: rāma rāma nivartasva kaṁ guṇaṁ tāta paśyasi,
14.29.22: neha yuktaṁ tvayā hantuṁ brāhmaṇena satā nr̥pān ॥22॥
14.29.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi brāhmaṇagītāsu ekonatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥29॥
14.30.1: śrutvā ca tat tathā kāryaṁ bhavatā dvijasattama ॥1॥
14.30.3: kr̥tvā suduṣkaraṁ karma manaḥ sūkṣme samādadhe ॥3॥
14.30.4: sthitasya vr̥kṣamūleṣu tasya cintā babhūva ha,
14.30.5: manaso me balaṁ jātaṁ mano jitvā dhruvo jayaḥ,
14.30.8: anyān bāṇān samīkṣasva yaistvaṁ māṁ sūdayiṣyasi,
14.30.9: tasmād ghrāṇaṁ prati śarān pratimokṣyāmyahaṁ śitān ॥9॥
14.30.11: anyān bāṇān samīkṣasva yaistvaṁ māṁ sūdayiṣyasi,
14.30.12: iyaṁ svādūn rasān bhuktvā tāneva pratigr̥dhyati,
14.30.14: anyān bāṇān samīkṣasva yaistvaṁ māṁ sūdayiṣyasi,
14.30.17: anyān bāṇān samīkṣasva yaistvaṁ māṁ sūdayiṣyasi,
14.30.19: tavaiva marma bhetsyanti tato hāsyasi jīvitam ॥19॥
14.30.20: anyān bāṇān samīkṣasva yaistvaṁ māṁ sūdayiṣyasi,
14.30.23: anyān bāṇān samīkṣasva yaistvaṁ māṁ sūdayiṣyasi,
14.30.24: tasmād buddhiṁ prati śarān pratimokṣyāmyahaṁ śitān ॥24॥
14.30.25: anyān bāṇān samīkṣasva yaistvaṁ māṁ sūdayiṣyasi ॥25॥
14.30.28: sa ekāgraṁ manaḥ kr̥tvā niścalo yogamāsthitaḥ ॥28॥
14.30.31: iti paścānmayā jñātaṁ yogānnāsti paraṁ sukham ॥31॥
14.30.32: iti tvamanujānīhi rāma mā kṣatriyān jahi,
14.30.33: ityuktaḥ sa tapo ghoraṁ jāmadagnyaḥ pitāmahaiḥ,
āsthitaḥ sumahābhāgo yayau siddhiṁ ca durgamām ॥33॥
14.30.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi brāhmaṇagītāsu triṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥30॥
14.31.1: trayo vai ripavo loke navadhā guṇataḥ smr̥tāḥ,
14.31.2: śramastandrā ca mohaśca trayaste tāmasā guṇāḥ ॥2॥
14.31.4: ambarīṣeṇa yā gītā rājñā pūrvaṁ praśāmyatā ॥4॥
14.31.6: sa nigr̥hyātmano doṣān sādhūn samabhipūjya ca,
jagāma mahatīṁ siddhiṁ gāthāścemā jagāda ha ॥6॥
14.31.7: eko doṣo variṣṭhaśca vadhyaḥ sa na hato mayā ॥7॥
14.31.8: tr̥ṣṇārta iha nimnāni dhāvamāno na budhyate ॥8॥
14.31.10: sa lipyamāno labhate bhūyiṣṭhaṁ rājasān guṇān,
tadavāptau tu labhate bhūyiṣṭhaṁ tamasān guṇān ॥10॥
14.31.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi brāhmaṇagītāsu ekatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥31॥
14.32.1: brāhmaṇasya ca saṁvādaṁ janakasya ca bhāvini ॥1॥
14.32.3: ācakṣva viṣayaṁ rājan yāvāṁstava vaśe sthitaḥ ॥3॥
14.32.7: samāśvāsya tato rājā vigate kaśmale tadā,
14.32.9: nādhigacchaṁ yadā pr̥thvyāṁ mithilā mārgitā mayā,
nādhyagacchaṁ yadā tasyāṁ svaprajā mārgitā mayā ॥9॥
14.32.10: nādhyagacchaṁ tadā tasyāṁ tadā me kaśmalo’bhavat,
14.32.11: tadā na viṣayaṁ manye sarvo vā viṣayo mama,
ātmāpi cāyaṁ na mama sarvā vā pr̥thivī mama ॥11॥
14.32.13: brūhi kāṁ matimāsthāya mamatvaṁ varjitaṁ tvayā ॥13॥
14.32.14: kāṁ vai buddhiṁ samāśritya sarvo vai viṣayastava,
nāvaiṣi viṣayaṁ yena sarvo vā viṣayastava ॥14॥
14.32.17: etāṁ buddhiṁ samāśritya mamatvaṁ varjitaṁ mayā,
śr̥ṇu buddhiṁ ca yāṁ jñātvā sarvatra viṣayo mama ॥17॥
14.32.19: āpo me nirjitāstasmād vaśe tiṣṭhanti nityadā ॥19॥
14.32.22: tasmānme nirjitāḥ śabdā vaśe tiṣṭhanti nityadā ॥22॥
14.32.23: mano me nirjitaṁ tasmād vaśe tiṣṭhati nityadā ॥23॥
14.32.24: ityarthaṁ sarva eveti samārambhā bhavanti vai ॥24॥
14.32.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhikeparvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi brāhmaṇagītāsu dvātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥32॥
14.33.2: nāhamasmi yathā māṁ tvaṁ paśyase ca śubhāśubhe,
14.33.3: ye kecijjantavo loke jaṅgamāḥ sthāvarāśca ha,
14.33.4: tathā buddhiriyaṁ vetti buddhireva dhanaṁ mama ॥4॥
14.33.5: ekaḥ panthā brāhmaṇānāṁ yena gacchanti tadvidaḥ,
14.33.7: buddhyāyaṁ gamyate mārgaḥ śarīreṇa na gamyate,
14.33.8: tasmāt te subhage nāsti paralokakr̥taṁ bhayam,
14.33.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi brāhmaṇagītāsu trayastriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥33॥
14.34.1: bahu cālpaṁ ca saṅkṣiptaṁ viplutaṁ ca mataṁ mama ॥1॥
14.34.2: upāyaṁ taṁ mama brūhi yenaiṣā labhyate matiḥ,
tanmanye kāraṇaṁ tvatto yata eṣā pravartate ॥2॥
14.34.4: yadidaṁ brāhmaṇo liṅgaṁ kṣetrajña iti sañjñitam,
grahītuṁ yena yacchakyaṁ lakṣaṇaṁ tasya tat kva nu ॥4॥
14.34.5: upāyameva vakṣyāmi yena gr̥hyeta vā na vā ॥5॥
14.34.9: yataḥ paraṁ na vidyeta tato’bhyāse bhaviṣyati ॥9॥
14.34.11: kva nu sā brāhmaṇī kr̥ṣṇa kva cāsau brāhmaṇarṣabhaḥ,
yābhyāṁ siddhiriyaṁ prāptā tāvubhau vada me’cyuta ॥11॥
14.34.12: mano me brāhmaṇaṁ viddhi buddhiṁ me viddhi brāhmaṇīm,
14.34.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi brāhmaṇagītāsu catustriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥34॥
14.35.1: bhavato hi prasādena sūkṣme me ramate matiḥ ॥1॥
14.35.4: yāce tvāṁ śirasā vipra yad brūyāṁ brūhi tanmama ॥4॥
14.35.5: sarvaṁ tu te pravakṣyāmi yatra vai saṁśayo dvija ॥5॥
14.35.7: kutaścāhaṁ kutaśca tvaṁ tatsatyaṁ brūhi yatparam,
kuto jātāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥7॥
14.35.8: kena jīvanti bhūtāni teṣāmāyuśca kiṁ param,
kiṁ satyaṁ kiṁ tapo vipra ke guṇāḥ sadbhirīritāḥ ॥8॥
14.35.9: ke panthānaḥ śivāśca syuḥ kiṁ sukhaṁ kiṁ ca duṣkr̥tam,
etān me bhagavan praśnān yāthātathyena suvrata ॥9॥
14.35.11: brūhi dharmavidāṁ śreṣṭha paraṁ kautūhalaṁ mama,
14.35.14: tān praśnānabravīt pārtha medhāvī sa dhr̥tavrataḥ,
14.35.16: jñānaṁ tveva paraṁ vidmaḥ saṁnyāsaṁ tapa uttamam,
14.35.17: yo vidvān sahasaṁvāsaṁ vivāsaṁ caiva paśyati,
14.35.27: r̥ṣimāṅgirasaṁ vr̥ddhaṁ puraskr̥tya tu te dvijāḥ,
14.35.29: kathaṁ karma kriyāt sādhu kathaṁ mucyeta kilbiṣāt,
ke no mārgāḥ śivāśca syuḥ kiṁ satyaṁ kiṁ ca duṣkr̥tam ॥29॥
14.35.31: tat te’haṁ sampravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu śiṣya yathāgamam ॥31॥
14.35.32: satyād bhūtāni jātāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca,
tapasā tāni jīvanti iti tad vitta suvratāḥ,
svāṁ yoniṁ samatikramya vartante svena karmaṇā ॥32॥
14.35.34: brahma satyaṁ tapaḥ satyaṁ satyaṁ caiva prajāpatiḥ,
satyād bhūtāni jātāni satyaṁ bhūtamayaṁ jagat ॥34॥
14.35.38: panthānaṁ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi śivaṁ kṣemakaraṁ dvijāḥ,
14.35.40: gārhasthyaṁ tu dvitīyaṁ syād vānaprasthamataḥ param,
tataḥ paraṁ tu vijñeyamadhyātmaṁ paramaṁ padam ॥40॥
14.35.47: indriyāṇi daśaikaṁ ca mahābhūtāni pañca ca ॥47॥
14.35.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde pañcatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥35॥
14.36.6: tamaso mithunaṁ sattvaṁ sattvasya mithunaṁ rajaḥ,
rajasaścāpi sattvaṁ syāt sattvasya mithunaṁ tamaḥ ॥6॥
14.36.7: niyamyate rajo yatra sattvaṁ tatra pravartate ॥7॥
14.36.8: tāmasaṁ rūpametat tu dr̥śyate cāpi saṅgatam ॥8॥
14.36.12: svapnaḥ stambho bhayaṁ lobhaḥ svataḥ sukr̥tadūṣaṇam ॥12॥
14.36.16: ye cānye vihitā bhāvā loke’smin bhāvasañjñitāḥ ॥16॥
14.36.17: tatra tatra niyamyante sarve te tāmasā guṇāḥ,
14.36.19: vr̥thārambhā hi ye kecid vr̥thā dānāni yāni ca,
14.36.23: sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni paśavo vāhanāni ca,
14.36.24: unmattā badhirā mūkā ye cānye pāparogiṇaḥ ॥24॥
14.36.27: anyathā pratipannāstu vivr̥ddhā ye ca karmaṇaḥ,
14.36.35: konvetad budhyate sādhu konvetat sādhu paśyati,
14.36.36: naro hi yo veda guṇānimān sadā
14.36.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde ṣaṭtriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥36॥
14.37.6: mr̥ṣā vādo mr̥ṣā dānaṁ vikalpaḥ paribhāṣaṇam,
nindā stutiḥ praśaṁsā ca prastāvaḥ pāradharṣaṇam ॥6॥
14.37.8: saṁskārā ye ca lokeṣu pravartante pr̥thakpr̥thak,
nr̥ṣu nārīṣu bhūteṣu dravyeṣu śaraṇeṣu ca ॥8॥
14.37.11: idaṁ me syādidaṁ me syātsneho guṇasamudbhavaḥ ॥11॥
14.37.12: stainyaṁ hiṁsā jugupsā ca paritāpaḥ prajāgaraḥ ॥12॥
14.37.13: dambho darpo’tha rāgaśca bhaktiḥ prītiḥ pramodanam,
dyūtaṁ ca janavādaśca sambandhāḥ strīkr̥tāśca ye ॥13॥
14.37.14: sarva ete guṇā viprā rājasāḥ samprakīrtitāḥ ॥14॥
14.37.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde saptatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥37॥
14.38.4: mudhā jñānaṁ mudhā vr̥ttaṁ mudhā sevā mudhā śramaḥ,
14.38.9: mudhā dānaṁ mudhā yajño mudhā’dhītaṁ mudhā vratam,
mudhā pratigrahaścaiva mudhā dharmo mudhā tapaḥ ॥9॥
14.38.11: hitvā sarvāṇi pāpāni niḥśokā hyatha mānavāḥ,
divaṁ prāpya tu te dhīrāḥ kurvate vai tatastanūḥ ॥11॥
14.38.12: īśitvaṁ ca vaśitvaṁ ca laghutvaṁ manasaśca te,
14.38.14: yad yadicchanti tat sarvaṁ bhajante vibhajanti ca,
ityetat sāttvikaṁ vr̥ttaṁ kathitaṁ vo dvijarṣabhāḥ,
etad vijñāya labhate vidhivad yad yadicchati ॥14॥
14.38.15: guṇān sa bhuṅkte na guṇaiḥ sa yujyate ॥15॥
14.38.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde’ṣṭatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥38॥
14.39.1: naiva śakyā guṇā vaktuṁ pr̥thaktvenaiva sarvaśaḥ,
14.39.5: vakṣyate tad yathā nyūnaṁ vyatiriktaṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥5॥
14.39.6: vyatiriktaṁ tamo yatra tiryag bhāvagataṁ bhavet,
alpaṁ tatra rajo jñeyaṁ sattvamalpataraṁ tathā ॥6॥
14.39.7: udriktaṁ ca rajo yatra madhyasrotogataṁ bhavet,
alpaṁ tatra tamo jñeyaṁ sattvamalpataraṁ tathā ॥7॥
14.39.8: alpaṁ tatra tamo jñeyaṁ rajaścālpataraṁ tathā ॥8॥
14.39.9: na hi sattvāt paro dharmaḥ kaścidanyo vidhīyate ॥9॥
14.39.10: ūrdhvaṁ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ,
14.39.11: tamaḥ śūdre rajaḥ kṣatre brāhmaṇe sattvamuttamam,
14.39.16: paryāyeṇa ca vartante tatra tatra tathā tathā ॥16॥
14.39.19: tridhā dānāni dīyante tridhā yajñaḥ pravartate,
14.39.20: bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca dharmo’rthaḥ kāma eva ca,
14.39.21: paryāyeṇa pravartante tatra tatra tathā tathā,
14.39.22: trayo guṇāḥ pravartante hyavyaktā nityameva tu,
14.39.23: tamo vyaktaṁ śivaṁ dhāma rajo yoniḥ sanātanaḥ,
14.39.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde ekonacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥39॥
14.40.3: taṁ jānan brāhmaṇo vidvān pramohaṁ nādhigacchati ॥3॥
14.40.8: ātmano mahato veda yaḥ puṇyāṁ gatimuttamām ॥8॥
14.40.13: evaṁ hi yo veda guhāśayaṁ prabhuṁ
14.40.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde catvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥40॥
14.41.1: ya utpanno mahān pūrvamahaṅkāraḥ sa ucyate,
14.41.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde ekacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥41॥
14.42.4: yad yasmājjāyate bhūtaṁ tatra tat pravilīyate,
14.42.6: śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṁ raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ,
14.42.11: aṣṭau yasyāgnayo hyete na dahane manaḥ sadā,
sa tad brahma śubhaṁ yāti tasmād bhūyo na vidyate ॥11॥
14.42.13: śrotraṁ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī,
pādau pāyurupasthaśca hastau vāg daśamī bhavet ॥13॥
14.42.14: etaṁ grāmaṁ jayet pūrvaṁ tato brahma prakāśate ॥14॥
14.42.16: ubhayatra mano jñeyaṁ buddhistu dvādaśī bhavet ॥16॥
14.42.19: dvitīyaṁ māruto bhūta tvagadhyātmaṁ ca viśrutā ॥19॥
14.42.23: eṣu pañcasu bhūteṣu triṣu yaśca vidhiḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥23॥
14.42.27: adhibhūtaṁ tathā śukraṁ daivataṁ ca prajāpatiḥ,
14.42.36: bhittvā tu pr̥thivīṁ yāni jāyante kālaparyayāt ॥36॥
14.42.39: tapaḥ karma ca yatpuṇyamityeṣa viduṣāṁ nayaḥ,
vividhaṁ karma vijñeyamijyā dānaṁ ca tanmakhe ॥39॥
14.42.40: etad yo vetti vidhivad yuktaḥ sa syād dvijarṣabhāḥ ॥40॥
14.42.46: vidvān kūrma ivāṅgāni kāmān saṁhr̥tya sarvaśaḥ,
virajāḥ sarvato mukto yo naraḥ sa sukhī sadā ॥46॥
14.42.51: agnī rūpaṁ payaḥ sroto vāyuḥ sparśanameva ca,
14.42.61: dhruvaṁ paśyati rūpāṇi dīpād dīpaśataṁ yathā,
sa vai viṣṇuśca mitraśca varuṇo’gniḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥61॥
14.42.62: sa hi dhātā vidhātā ca sa prabhuḥ sarvatomukhaḥ,
14.42.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde dvicatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥42॥
14.43.1: manuṣyāṇāṁ tu rājanyaḥ kṣatriyo madhyamo guṇaḥ,
14.43.2: gavāṁ govr̥ṣabhaścaiva strīṇāṁ puruṣa eva ca ॥2॥
14.43.4: ete drumāṇāṁ rājāno loke’smin nātra saṁśayaḥ,
14.43.10: dīkṣitānāṁ tathā yajño daivānāṁ maghavā tathā,
14.43.11: eva bhūtādhipaḥ sargaḥ prajānāṁ ca prajāpatiḥ ॥11॥
14.43.12: bhūtaṁ parataraṁ matto viṣṇorvāpi na vidyate ॥12॥
14.43.15: māheśvarī mahādevī procyate pārvatī hi sā ॥15॥
14.43.17: tasmād rājā dvijātīnāṁ prayateta sma rakṣaṇe ॥17॥
14.43.19: rājñāṁ hi viṣaye yeṣāṁ sādhavaḥ parirakṣitāḥ,
te’smim̐lloke pramodante sukhaṁ pretya ca bhuñjate ॥19॥
14.43.29: pārthivo yastu gandho vai ghrāṇena hi sa gr̥hyate,
14.43.30: apāṁ dhātū raso nityaṁ jihvayā sa tu gr̥hyate,
14.43.31: jyotiṣaśca guṇo rūpaṁ cakṣuṣā tacca gr̥hyate,
14.43.32: vāyavyastu sadā sparśastvācā prajñāyate ca saḥ,
tvaksthaścaiva sadā vāyuḥ sparśane sa vidhīyate ॥32॥
14.43.33: ākāśasya guṇo hyeṣa śrotreṇa ca sa gr̥hyate,
14.43.34: manasaśca guṇaścintā prajñayā sa tu gr̥hyate,
14.43.37: sadā paśyāmyahaṁ līno vijānāmi śr̥ṇomi ca ॥37॥
14.43.39: na guṇā vidurātmānaṁ sr̥jyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥39॥
14.43.40: na satyaṁ vindate kaścit kṣetrajñastveva vindati,
guṇānāṁ guṇabhūtānāṁ yat paraṁ paramaṁ mahat ॥40॥
14.43.41: tasmād guṇāṁśca sattvaṁ ca parityajyeha dharmavit,
14.43.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde tricatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥43॥
14.44.2: ahaḥ pūrvaṁ tato rātrirmāsāḥ śuklādayaḥ smr̥tāḥ,
14.44.6: oṅkāraḥ sarvavedānāṁ vacasāṁ prāṇa eva ca,
14.44.11: brahmakṣetraṁ sadā puṇyaṁ plakṣaḥ prathamataḥ smr̥taḥ ॥11॥
14.44.12: ahaṁ prajāpatīnāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ,
14.44.13: diśāṁ ca pradiśāṁ cordhvaṁ dikpūrvā prathamā tathā ॥13॥
14.44.16: bhūtaṁ parataraṁ yasmāt trailokye neha vidyate ॥16॥
14.44.17: āśramāṇāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ gārhasthyaṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ,
14.44.18: sukhasyāntaṁ sadā duḥkhaṁ duḥkhasyāntaṁ sadā sukham ॥18॥
14.44.20: sarvaṁ kr̥taṁ vināśāntaṁ jātasya maraṇaṁ dhruvam,
14.44.21: iṣṭaṁ dattaṁ tapo’dhītaṁ vratāni niyamāśca ye,
14.44.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde catuścatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥44॥
14.45.11: yastu veda naro nityaṁ na sa bhūteṣu muhyati ॥11॥
14.45.18: na ca vāgaṅgacapala iti śiṣṭasya gocaraḥ ॥18॥
14.45.20: vaiṇavīṁ dhārayed yaṣṭiṁ sodakaṁ ca kamaṇḍalum ॥20॥
14.45.22: trīṇi karmāṇi jānīta brāhmaṇānāṁ tu jīvikā,
14.45.23: atha śeṣāṇi cānyāni trīṇi karmāṇi yāni tu,
14.45.25: evaṁ yukto jayet svargaṁ gr̥hasthaḥ saṁśitavrataḥ ॥25॥
14.45.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde pañcacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥45॥
14.46.4: dhārayīta sadā daṇḍaṁ bailvaṁ pālāśameva vā ॥4॥
14.46.5: sarvaṁ kāṣāyaraktaṁ vā vāso vāpi dvijasya ha ॥5॥
14.46.10: araṇyagocaro nityaṁ na grāmaṁ praviśet punaḥ ॥10॥
14.46.13: yad bhakṣyaṁ syāt tato dadyād bhikṣāṁ nityamatandritaḥ ॥13॥
14.46.15: dānto maitraḥ kṣamāyuktaḥ keśān śmaśru ca dhārayan,
14.46.16: evaṁ yukto jayet svargaṁ vānaprastho jitendriyaḥ ॥16॥
14.46.17: gr̥hastho brahmacārī ca vānaprastho’tha vā punaḥ,
14.46.19: kr̥tvā prāhṇe cared bhaikṣyaṁ vidhūme bhuktavajjane ॥19॥
14.46.20: lābhena ca na hr̥ṣyeta nālābhe vimanā bhavet,
14.46.27: dayārthaṁ caiva bhūtānāṁ samīkṣya pr̥thivīṁ caret ॥27॥
14.46.28: sañcayāṁśca na kurvīta snehavāsaṁ ca varjayet,
14.46.34: parebhyo na pratigrāhyaṁ na ca deyaṁ kadācana,
14.46.35: na kiñcid viṣayaṁ bhuktvā spr̥hayet tasya vai punaḥ ॥35॥
14.46.37: na dveṣṭā nopadeṣṭā ca bhavecca nirupaskr̥taḥ ॥37॥
14.46.40: samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca ॥40॥
14.46.43: na cakṣuṣā na manasā na vācā dūṣayet kvacit,
na pratyakṣaṁ parokṣaṁ vā kiñcid duṣṭaṁ samācaret ॥43॥
14.46.46: ātmasaṅgī ca tattvajño mucyate nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥46॥
14.46.49: sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṁ ye paśyanti na te mr̥tāḥ ॥49॥
14.46.50: na tatra kramate buddhirnendriyāṇi na devatāḥ,
vedā yajñāśca lokāśca na tapo na vratāni ca ॥50॥
14.46.54: ya evaṁ vr̥ttasampannaḥ sa muniḥ śreṣṭha ucyate,
14.46.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde ṣaṭcatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥46॥
14.47.1: brāhmaṇā brahmayonisthā jñānaṁ brahma paraṁ viduḥ ॥1॥
14.47.3: jñānena tapasā caiva dhīrāḥ paśyanti tat param,
14.47.4: saṁnyāsaniratā nityaṁ ye ca brahmavido janāḥ ॥4॥
14.47.5: jñānaṁ vai paramaṁ vidyāt saṁnyāsaṁ tapa uttamam ॥5॥
14.47.7: yo vidvān sahavāsaṁ ca vivāsaṁ caiva paśyati,
14.47.11: hitvā guṇamayaṁ sarvaṁ karma jantuḥ śubhāśubham,
ubhe satyānr̥te hitvā mucyate nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥11॥
14.47.14: enaṁ chittvā ca bhittvā ca tattvajñānāsinā budhaḥ ॥14॥
14.47.16: etābhyāṁ tu paro yo’nyaścetanāvān sa ucyate ॥16॥
14.47.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde saptacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥47॥
14.48.1: kecid brahmamayaṁ vr̥kṣaṁ kecid brahmavanaṁ mahat,
14.48.4: prāṇāyāmairatha prāṇān saṁyamya sa punaḥ punaḥ,
14.48.5: evaṁ pūrvaṁ prasannātmā labhate yad yadicchati,
14.48.8: sattvaṁ ca puruṣaścaiva tatra nāsti vicāraṇā ॥8॥
14.48.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde aṣṭacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥48॥
14.49.7: karma kecit praśaṁsanti praśāntiṁ cāpare janāḥ ॥7॥
14.49.14: idaṁ śreya idaṁ śreya ityevaṁ vyutthito janaḥ,
yo hi yasmin rato dharme sa taṁ pūjayate sadā ॥14॥
14.49.16: ataḥ paraṁ tu yad guhyaṁ tad bhavān vaktumarhati,
14.49.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde ekonapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥49॥
14.50.1: hanta vaḥ sampravakṣyāmi yanmāṁ pr̥cchatha sattamāḥ,
14.50.4: hiṁsāparāśca ye kecid ye ca nāstikavr̥ttayaḥ,
14.50.6: kurvate ye tu karmāṇi śraddadhānā vipaścitaḥ,
14.50.8: viṣayī puruṣo nityaṁ sattvaṁ ca viṣayaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥8॥
14.50.9: yastvevaṁ taṁ vijānīte yo bhuṅkte yaśca bhujyate ॥9॥
14.50.14: yathā dravyaṁ ca kartā ca saṁyogo’pyanayostathā,
14.50.16: etad viprā vijānīta hanta bhūyo bravīmi vaḥ ॥16॥
14.50.20: tathā karmasu vijñeyaṁ phalaṁ bhavati vā na vā,
14.50.24: yāvad rathapathastāvad rathena sa tu gacchati,
14.50.27: nāvā cāpi yathā prājño vibhāgajñaḥ svaritrayā,
14.50.28: tīrṇo gacchet paraṁ pāraṁ nāvamutsr̥jya nirmamaḥ,
14.50.29: snehāt sammohamāpanno nāvi dāśo yathā tathā,
14.50.31: evaṁ karma kr̥taṁ citraṁ viṣayasthaṁ pr̥thak pr̥thak,
14.50.32: manyante munayo buddhyā tat pradhānaṁ pracakṣate ॥32॥
14.50.34: pr̥thaktvena hi bhūtānāṁ viṣayā vai guṇāḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥34॥
14.50.40: śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṁ raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ,
14.50.41: pārthivaśca sadā gandho gandhaśca bahudhā smr̥taḥ,
tasya gandhasya vakṣyāmi vistareṇa bahūn guṇān ॥41॥
14.50.42: nirhārī saṁhataḥ snigdho rūkṣo viśada eva ca ॥42॥
14.50.43: evaṁ daśavidho jñeyaḥ pārthivo gandha ityuta,
śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṁ dravaścāṇāṁ guṇāḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥43॥
14.50.44: rasajñānaṁ tu vakṣyāmi rasastu bahudhā smr̥taḥ,
14.50.46: jyotiṣaśca guṇo rūpaṁ rūpaṁ ca bahudhā smr̥tam,
śuklaṁ kr̥ṣṇaṁ tathā raktaṁ nīlaṁ pītāruṇaṁ tathā ॥46॥
14.50.47: hrasvaṁ dīrghaṁ kr̥śaṁ sthūlaṁ caturasraṁ tu vr̥ttavat,
14.50.49: vāyoścāpi guṇaḥ sparśaḥ sparśaśca bahudhā smr̥taḥ,
rūkṣaḥ śītastathaivoṣṇaḥ snigdho viśada eva ca ॥49॥
14.50.52: tasya śabdasya vakṣyāmi vistareṇa bahūn guṇān ॥52॥
14.50.53: ataḥ paraṁ tu vijñeyo niṣādo dhaivatastathā,
14.50.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥50॥
14.51.1: niyame ca visarge ca bhūtātmā mana eva ca ॥1॥
14.51.2: adhiṣṭhātā mano nityaṁ bhūtānāṁ mahatāṁ tathā,
14.51.3: indriyāṇi mano buddhiḥ kṣetrajñe yujyate sadā ॥3॥
14.51.6: evaṁ yo vetti vidvān vai sadā brahmamayaṁ ratham,
14.51.10: loke’smin yāni sattvāni trasāni sthāvarāṇi ca,
14.51.11: sarve svabhāvataḥ sr̥ṣṭā na kriyābhyo na kāraṇāt ॥11॥
14.51.12: ete viśvasr̥jo viprā jāyantīha punaḥ punaḥ,
14.51.13: bhūtebhyaścāpi pañcabhyo mukto gacchet parāṁ gatim ॥13॥
14.51.17: tat sarvaṁ tapasā sādhyaṁ tapo hi duratikramam ॥17॥
14.51.19: yāni cānyāni bhūtāni trasāni sthāvarāṇi ca ॥19॥
14.51.20: tathaiva tapasā devā mahāmāyā divaṁ gatāḥ ॥20॥
14.51.26: kṣetrajña iti taṁ vidyād yastaṁ veda sa vedavit ॥26॥
14.51.29: mameti ca bhavenmr̥tyurna mameti ca śāśvatam ॥29॥
14.51.30: ye tu vr̥ddhā mahātmāno na praśaṁsanti karma te ॥30॥
14.51.32: tasmāt karmasu niḥsnehā ye kecit pāradarśinaḥ,
vidyāmayo’yaṁ puruṣo na tu karmamayaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥32॥
14.51.33: vaśyātmānamasaṁśliṣṭaṁ yo veda na mr̥to bhavet ॥33॥
14.51.35: sa tad brahma śubhaṁ vetti yasmād bhūyo na vidyate ॥35॥
14.51.36: lakṣaṇaṁ hi prasādasya yathā syāt svapnadarśanam ॥36॥
14.51.41: ityuktāste tu munayo guruṇā brahmaṇā tathā,
14.51.43: ityuktaḥ sa tadā śiṣyo guruṇā dharmamuttamam,
14.51.44: tat padaṁ samanuprāpto yatra gatvā na śocati ॥44॥
14.51.45: ko nvasau brāhmaṇaḥ kr̥ṣṇa kaśca śiṣyo janārdana,
śrotavyaṁ cenmayaitad vai tattvamācakṣva me vibho ॥45॥
14.51.46: ahaṁ gururmahābāho manaḥ śiṣyaṁ ca viddhi me,
14.51.49: mayā tava mahābāho tasmādatra manaḥ kuru ॥49॥
14.51.50: mayā tu bharataśreṣṭha ciradr̥ṣṭaḥ pitā prabhuḥ,
14.51.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi guruśiṣyasaṁvāde ekapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥51॥
14.52.9: ratiḥ krīḍāmayī tubhyaṁ māyā te rodasī vibho ॥9॥
14.52.10: tvayi sarvamidaṁ viśvaṁ yadidaṁ sthāṇu jaṅgamam,
tvaṁ hi sarvaṁ vikuruṣe bhūtagrāmaṁ caturvidham ॥10॥
14.52.11: pr̥thivīṁ cāntarikṣaṁ ca dyāṁ caiva madhusūdana,
14.52.12: prāṇo vāyuḥ satatagaḥ krodho mr̥tyuḥ sanātanaḥ,
prasāde cāpi padmā śrīrnityaṁ tvayi mahāmate ॥12॥
14.52.14: sudīrgheṇāpi kālena na te śakyā guṇā mayā,
ātmā ca paramātmā ca namaste nalinekṣaṇa ॥14॥
14.52.15: vidito me sudurdharṣa nāradād devalāt tathā,
14.52.18: tvayā dagdhaṁ hi tatsainyaṁ mayā vijitamāhave ॥18॥
14.52.19: bhavatā tatkr̥taṁ karma yenāvāpto jayo mayā,
14.52.20: saindhavasya ca pāpasya bhūriśravasa eva ca ॥20॥
14.52.21: yaduktastat kariṣyāmi na hi me’tra vicāraṇā ॥21॥
14.52.23: acirādeva draṣṭā tvaṁ mātulaṁ me janārdana ॥23॥
14.52.26: viduraṁ ca mahābuddhiṁ rājānaṁ ca yudhiṣṭhiram ॥26॥
14.52.27: bhīmasenaṁ ca durdharṣaṁ mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau,
14.52.28: gāndhārīṁ ca mahāprajñāṁ pr̥thāṁ kr̥ṣṇāṁ ca bhāminīm,
14.52.32: taiḥ sārdhaṁ nr̥patiṁ vr̥ddhaṁ tatastau paryupāsatām,
14.52.33: janārdanaṁ ca medhāvī vyasarjayata vai gr̥hān,
te’nujñātā nr̥patinā yayuḥ svaṁ svaṁ niveśanam ॥33॥
14.52.35: prabhātāyāṁ tu śarvaryāṁ kr̥tvā paurvāhṇikīṁ kriyām ॥35॥
14.52.37: tau praviśya mahātmānau tad gr̥haṁ paramārcitam,
14.52.39: tataḥ sa rājā medhāvī vivakṣū prekṣya tāvubhau,
14.52.40: vivakṣū hi yuvāṁ manye vīrau yadukurūdvahau,
brūtaṁ kartāsmi sarvaṁ vāṁ nacirānmā vicāryatām ॥40॥
14.52.44: puṇḍarīkākṣa bhadraṁ te gaccha tvaṁ madhusūdana,
14.52.45: rocate me mahābāho gamanaṁ tava keśava,
mātulaściradr̥ṣṭo me tvayā devī ca devakī ॥45॥
14.52.46: sametya mātulaṁ gatvā baladevaṁ ca mānada,
14.52.47: smarethāścāpi māṁ nityaṁ bhīmaṁ ca balināṁ varam,
phālgunaṁ sahadevaṁ ca nakulaṁ caiva mānada ॥47॥
14.52.49: sa gaccha ratnānyādāya vividhāni vasūni ca,
14.52.50: iyaṁ ca vasudhā kr̥tsnā prasādāt tava keśava,
14.52.52: dharā tu kr̥tsnā tu mahābhujādya vai,
14.52.57: stataḥ sa sarvān viduraṁ ca vīryavān,
14.52.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇaprayāṇe dvipañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥52॥
14.53.2: ā cakṣurviṣayāccainaṁ sa dadarśa punaḥ punaḥ ॥2॥
14.53.3: kr̥cchreṇaiva tu tāṁ pārtho govinde viniveśitām,
14.53.6: vavarṣa vāsavaścaiva toyaṁ śuci sugandhi ca,
14.53.8: sa taṁ sampūjya tejasvī muniṁ pr̥thulalocanaḥ,
14.53.9: sa pr̥ṣṭaḥ kuśalaṁ tena sampūjya madhusūdanam,
14.53.13: svarāṣṭre te ca rājānaḥ kaccit prāpsyanti vai sukham,
14.53.14: yā me sambhāvanā tāta tvayi nityamavartata,
api sā saphalā tāta kr̥tā te bharatān prati ॥14॥
14.53.15: kr̥to yatno mayā pūrvaṁ sauśāmye kauravān prati,
14.53.16: na diṣṭamapyatikrāntuṁ śakyaṁ buddhyā balena vā ॥16॥
14.53.17: te’tyakrāman matiṁ mahyaṁ bhīṣmasya vidurasya ca ॥17॥
14.53.20: yasmācchaktena te kr̥ṣṇa na trātāḥ kurupuṅgavāḥ,
14.53.21: na ca te prasabhaṁ yasmāt te nigr̥hya nivāritāḥ,
14.53.22: tvayā śaktena hi satā mithyācāreṇa mādhava,
te parītāḥ kuruśreṣṭhā naśyantaḥ sma hyupekṣitāḥ ॥22॥
14.53.23: śr̥ṇu me vistareṇedaṁ yad vakṣye bhr̥gunandana,
14.53.24: śrutvā ca me tadadhyātmaṁ muñcethāḥ śāpamadya vai,
na ca māṁ tapasālpena śakto’bhibhavituṁ pumān ॥24॥
14.53.25: na ca te tapaso nāśamicchāmi tapatāṁ vara,
14.53.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi uttaṅkopākhyāne kr̥ṣṇottaṅkasamāgame tripañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥53॥
14.54.1: śrutvā śreyo’bhidhāsyāmi śāpaṁ vā te janārdana ॥1॥
14.54.2: tamo rajaśca sattvaṁ ca viddhi bhāvān madāśrayān,
tathā rudrān vasūn vāpi viddhi matprabhavān dvija ॥2॥
14.54.6: ye cāśrameṣu vai dharmāścaturdhā viditā mune,
vaidikāni ca sarvāṇi viddhi sarvaṁ madātmakam ॥6॥
14.54.7: asacca sadasaccaiva yad viśvaṁ sadasat param,
14.54.8: oṅkārapramukhān vedān viddhi māṁ tvaṁ bhr̥gūdvaha,
yūpaṁ somaṁ caruṁ homaṁ tridaśāpyāyanaṁ makhe ॥8॥
14.54.9: hotāramapi havyaṁ ca viddhi māṁ bhr̥gunandana,
14.54.15: bhūtagrāmasya sarvasya sraṣṭā saṁhāra eva ca,
14.54.16: dharmasya setuṁ badhnāmi calite calite yuge,
14.54.19: nāgayonau yadā caiva tadā vartāmi nāgavat,
14.54.20: mānuṣye vartamāne tu kr̥paṇaṁ yācitā mayā,
na ca te jātasammohā vaco’gr̥hṇanta me hitam ॥20॥
14.54.21: bhayaṁ ca mahaduddiśya trāsitāḥ kuravo mayā,
14.54.22: dharmeṇa nihatā yuddhe gatāḥ svargaṁ na saṁśayaḥ ॥22॥
14.54.23: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥23॥
14.54.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi uttaṅkopākhyāne kr̥ṣṇavākye catuṣpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥54॥
14.55.2: vinivr̥ttaṁ ca me śāpāditi viddhi parantapa ॥2॥
14.55.4: tataḥ sa tasmai prītātmā darśayāmāsa tad vapuḥ,
śāśvataṁ vaipṇavaṁ dhīmān dadr̥śe yad dhanañjayaḥ ॥4॥
14.55.6: vismayaṁ ca yayau viprastaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā parameśvaram ॥6॥
14.55.7: padbhyāṁ te pr̥thivī vyāptā śirasā cāvr̥taṁ nabhaḥ ॥7॥
14.55.11: yat te rūpamidaṁ kr̥ṣṇa paśyāmi puruṣottama ॥11॥
14.55.12: tamabravīt punaḥ kr̥ṣṇo mā tvamatra vicāraya,
14.55.18: smaranneva ca taṁ prāha mātaṅgaḥ prahasanniva,
14.55.19: kr̥pā hi me sumahatī tvāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tr̥ṭ samāśritam,
14.55.20: cikṣepa ca sa taṁ dhīmān vāgbhirugrābhiracyutam,
14.55.21: sa tathā niścayāt tena pratyākhyāto mahātmanā ॥21॥
14.55.24: na yuktaṁ tādr̥śaṁ dātuṁ tvayā puruṣasattama ॥24॥
14.55.26: yādr̥śeneha rūpeṇa yogyaṁ dātuṁ dhr̥tena vai ॥26॥
14.55.27: tādr̥śaṁ khalu te dattaṁ yacca tvaṁ nāvabudhyathāḥ,
14.55.28: sa māmuvāca devendro na martyo’martyatāṁ vrajet ॥28॥
14.55.33: sa tathā samayaṁ kr̥tvā tena rūpeṇa vāsavaḥ,
14.55.34: yat tu śakyaṁ mayā kartuṁ bhūya eva tavepsitam ॥34॥
14.55.35: yeṣvahaḥsu ca te brahman salilepsā bhaviṣyati ॥35॥
14.55.37: uttaṅkameghā ityuktāḥ khyātiṁ yāsyanti cāpi te,
ityuktaḥ prītimān vipraḥ kr̥ṣṇena sa babhūva ha,
14.55.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi uttaṅkopākhyāne pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥55॥
14.56.1: uttaṅkaḥ kena tapasā saṁyukto vai mahāmanāḥ,
14.56.5: sa tasya damaśaucābhyāṁ vikrāntena ca karmaṇā,
14.56.6: taṁ krameṇa jarā tāta pratipede mahāmunim ॥6॥
14.56.10: tataḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ saha tadā papāta dharaṇītale,
14.56.13: na hi tānaśrupātāṁstu śaktā dhārayituṁ mahī ॥13॥
14.56.14: sa svairaṁ brūhi viprarṣe śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ॥14॥
14.56.16: jareyaṁ nāvabuddhā me nābhijñātaṁ sukhaṁ ca me,
14.56.19: kiṁ tvadya yadi te śraddhā gamanaṁ prati bhārgava,
anujñāṁ pratigr̥hya tvaṁ svagr̥hān gaccha mā ciram ॥19॥
14.56.20: gurvarthaṁ kaṁ prayacchāmi brūhi tvaṁ dvijasattama,
14.56.21: tava hyācarato brahmaṁstuṣṭo’haṁ vai na saṁśayaḥ ॥21॥
14.56.22: itthaṁ ca parituṣṭaṁ māṁ vijānīhi bhr̥gūdvaha,
yuvā ṣoḍaśavarṣo hi yadyadya bhavitā bhavān ॥22॥
14.56.23: dadāni patnīṁ kanyāṁ ca svāṁ te duhitaraṁ dvija,
14.56.25: kaṁ bhavatyai prayacchāmi gurvarthaṁ viniyuṅkṣva mām,
priyaṁ hitaṁ ca kāṅkṣāmi prāṇairapi dhanairapi ॥25॥
14.56.26: yad durlabhaṁ hi loke’smin ratnamatyadbhutaṁ mahat,
tadānayeyaṁ tapasā na hi me’trāsti saṁśayaḥ ॥26॥
14.56.27: parituṣṭāsmi te vipra nityaṁ bhaktyā tavānagha,
paryāptametad bhadraṁ te gaccha tāta yathepsitam ॥27॥
14.56.28: ājñāpayasva māṁ mātaḥ kartavyaṁ ca tava priyam ॥28॥
14.56.29: te samānaya bhadraṁ te gurvarthaḥ sukr̥to bhavet ॥29॥
14.56.32: iti pr̥ṣṭā tamācaṣṭa kuṇḍalārthe gataṁ ca sā ॥32॥
14.56.33: tataḥ provāca patnīṁ sa na te samyagidaṁ kr̥tam,
śaptaḥ sa pārthivo nūnaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ taṁ vadhiṣyati ॥33॥
14.56.34: ajānantyā niyuktaḥ sa bhagavan brāhmaṇo mayā,
14.56.35: uttaṅko’pi vane śūnye rājānaṁ taṁ dadarśa ha ॥35॥
14.56.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi uttaṅkopākhyāne kuṇḍalāharaṇe ṣaṭpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥56॥
14.57.1: sa taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tathābhūtaṁ rājānaṁ ghoradarśanam,
14.57.2: cakāra na vyathāṁ vipro rājā tvenamathābravīt,
14.57.3: diṣṭyā tvamasi kalyāṇa ṣaṣṭhe kāle mamāntikam,
14.57.5: na śakyastvaṁ samutsraṣṭuṁ kṣudhitena mayādya vai ॥5॥
14.57.6: evamastu mahārāja samayaḥ kriyatāṁ tu me,
14.57.7: tvadadhīnaḥ sa rājendra taṁ tvāṁ bhikṣe nareśvara ॥7॥
14.57.8: dātā ca tvaṁ naravyāghra pātrabhūtaḥ kṣitāviha,
pātraṁ pratigrahe cāpi viddhi māṁ nr̥pasattama ॥8॥
14.57.10: satyaṁ te pratijānāmi nātra mithyā kathañcana,
14.57.11: yadi mattastavāyatto gurvarthaḥ kr̥ta eva saḥ,
yadi cāsmi pratigrāhyaḥ sāmprataṁ tad vadasva me ॥11॥
14.57.12: pratigrāhyo mato me tvaṁ sadaiva puruṣarṣabha,
14.57.13: varayārthaṁ tvamanyaṁ vai taṁ te dāsyāmi suvrata ॥13॥
14.57.14: alaṁ te vyapadeśena pramāṇā yadi te vayam,
prayaccha kuṇḍale mahyaṁ satyavāg bhava pārthiva ॥14॥
14.57.15: gaccha madvacanād devīṁ brūhi dehīti sattama ॥15॥
14.57.16: pradāsyati dvijaśreṣṭha kuṇḍale te na saṁśayaḥ ॥16॥
14.57.17: kva patnī bhavataḥ śakyā mayā draṣṭuṁ nareśvara,
svayaṁ vāpi bhavān patnīṁ kimarthaṁ nopasarpati ॥17॥
14.57.18: ṣaṣṭhe kāle na hi mayā sā śakyā draṣṭumadya vai ॥18॥
14.57.19: madayantīṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvā sa jñāpayat svaprayojanam ॥19॥
14.57.25: syandete hi divā rukmaṁ rātrau ca dvijasattama,
14.57.27: hrasvena caite āmukte bhavato hrasvake tadā,
14.57.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi uttaṅkopākhyāne saptapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥57॥
14.58.2: na caivaiṣā gatiḥ kṣemyā na cānyā vidyate gatiḥ,
14.58.3: śrutvā ca sā tadā prādāt tataste maṇikuṇḍale ॥3॥
14.58.4: avāpya kuṇḍale te tu rājānaṁ punarabravīt,
14.58.5: prajānisargād viprān vai kṣatriyāḥ pūjayanti ha,
14.58.7: na cānyāmapi paśyāmi gatiṁ gatimatāṁ vara,
14.58.8: na hi rājñā viśeṣeṇa viruddhena dvijātibhiḥ,
śakyaṁ hi loke sthātuṁ vai pretya vā sukhamedhitum ॥8॥
14.58.9: tadiṣṭe te mayā datte ete sve maṇikuṇḍale,
yaḥ kr̥taste’dya samayaḥ saphalaṁ taṁ kuruṣva me ॥9॥
14.58.10: praśnaṁ ca kañcit praṣṭuṁ tvāṁ nivr̥tto’smi parantapa ॥10॥
14.58.11: brūhi vipra yathākāmaṁ prativaktāsmi te vacaḥ,
chettāsmi saṁśayaṁ te’dya na me’trāsti vicāraṇā ॥11॥
14.58.12: mitreṣu yaśca viṣamaḥ stena ityeva taṁ viduḥ ॥12॥
14.58.13: sa bhavān mitratāmadya samprāpto mama pārthiva,
sa me buddhiṁ prayacchasva sammatāṁ puruṣarṣabha ॥13॥
14.58.14: bhavatsakāśamāgantuṁ kṣamaṁ mama na veti vai ॥14॥
14.58.16: āgacchato hi te vipra bhavenmr̥tyurna saṁśayaḥ ॥16॥
14.58.17: ityuktaḥ sa tadā rājñā kṣamaṁ buddhimatā hitam,
14.58.19: tathā te kuṇḍale baddhvā tadā kr̥ṣṇājine’nayat ॥19॥
14.58.20: bilvaṁ dadarśa viprarṣirāruroha ca taṁ tataḥ ॥20॥
14.58.23: yasmiṁste kuṇḍale baddhe tadā dvijavareṇa vai,
14.58.25: apaśyad bhujagaḥ kaścit te tatra maṇikuṇḍale,
airāvatakulodbhūtaḥ śīghro bhūtvā tadā hi saḥ ॥25॥
14.58.26: hriyamāṇe tu dr̥ṣṭvā sa kuṇḍale bhujagena ha ॥26॥
14.58.32: sa tu taṁ brāhmaṇo bhūtvā tasya duḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ,
14.58.33: ito hi nāgaloko vai yojanāni sahasraśaḥ,
na daṇḍakāṣṭhasādhyaṁ ca manye kāryamidaṁ tava ॥33॥
14.58.34: nāgaloke yadi brahman na śakye kuṇḍale mayā,
14.58.35: yadā sa nāśakat tasya niścayaṁ kartumanyathā,
14.58.37: sa tena mārgeṇa tadā nāgalokaṁ viveśa ha,
14.58.40: tasya lokasya ca dvāraṁ sa dadarśa bhr̥gūdvahaḥ,
14.58.44: mā jugupsāṁ kr̥thāḥ putra tvamatrārthe kathañcana,
14.58.47: tasmācchreyo vidhāsyāmi tavaivaṁ kuru mā ciram ॥47॥
14.58.56: prasādya brāhmaṇaṁ te tu pādyamarghyaṁ nivedya ca,
14.58.57: agniṁ pradakṣiṇaṁ kr̥tvā jagāma gurusadma tat ॥57॥
14.58.58: sa gatvā tvarito rājan gautamasya niveśanam,
14.58.61: pareṇa tapasā yukto yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥61॥
14.58.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi uttaṅkopākhyāne aṣṭapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥58॥
14.59.1: ata ūrdhvaṁ mahābāhuḥ kiṁ cakāra mahāyaśāḥ ॥1॥
14.59.2: uttaṅkāya varaṁ dattvā prāyāt sātyakinā saha,
14.59.8: pumbhiḥ strībhiśca saṅghuṣṭaḥ pragīta iva cābhavat ॥8॥
14.59.9: mattānāṁ hr̥ṣṭarūpāṇāṁ strīṇāṁ puṁsāṁ ca bhārata ॥9॥
14.59.15d2: tvayā yat kriyate deva na jānīmo’tra māyayā,
14.59.15d3: brahmādīnāṁ ca govinda sāṁnidhyaṁ śaraṇaṁ namaḥ.
14.59.16: tataḥ sampūjyamānaḥ sa viveśa bhavanaṁ śubham ॥16॥
14.59.19: sa tānabhyarcya medhāvī pr̥ṣṭvā ca kuśalaṁ tadā,
14.59.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇasya dvārakāpraveśe ekonaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥59॥
14.60.1: narāṇāṁ vadatāṁ tatra kathaṁ vā teṣu nityaśaḥ ॥1॥
14.60.2: tvaṁ tu pratyakṣadarśī ca rūpajñaśca mahābhuja,
14.60.12: akarot sa tataḥ kālaṁ śaratalpagato muniḥ,
14.60.15: gupto bhīmena medhāvī mitreṇa varuṇo yathā ॥15॥
14.60.21: tataḥ pārthaṁ samāsādya pataṅga iva pāvakam,
14.60.22: hate karṇe tu kauravyā nirutsāhā hataujasaḥ,
14.60.25: hate śalye tu śakuniṁ sahadevo mahāmanāḥ,
14.60.27: hrade dvaipāyane cāpi salilasthaṁ dadarśa tam ॥27॥
14.60.30: tataḥ sa nihato rājā dhārtarāṣṭro mahāraṇe,
14.60.31: tatastat pāṇḍavaṁ sainyaṁ prasuptaṁ śibire niśi,
14.60.36: śr̥ṇvatāṁ tu mahārāja kathāṁ tāṁ lomaharṣaṇām,
14.60.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi vāsudevavākye ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥60॥
14.61.5: dr̥ṣṭvaiva ca papātorvyāṁ so’pi duḥkhena mūrcchitaḥ ॥5॥
14.61.7: nanu tvaṁ puṇḍarīkākṣa satyavāg bhuvi viśrutaḥ ॥7॥
14.61.8: yad dauhitravadhaṁ me’dya na khyāpayasi śatruhan,
14.61.9: durmaraṁ bata vārṣṇeya kāle’prāpte nr̥bhiḥ saha ॥9॥
14.61.10: yatra me hr̥dayaṁ duḥkhācchatadhā na vidīryate,
kimabravīt tvāṁ saṅgrāme subhadrāṁ mātaraṁ prati ॥10॥
14.61.11: māṁ cāpi puṇḍarīkākṣa capalākṣaḥ priyo mama,
āhavaṁ pr̥ṣṭhataḥ kr̥tvā kaccinna nihataḥ paraiḥ ॥11॥
14.61.12: kaccinmukhaṁ na govinda tenājau vikr̥taṁ kr̥tam,
sa hi kr̥ṣṇa mahātejāḥ ślāghanniva mamāgrataḥ ॥12॥
14.61.14: sa hi droṇaṁ ca bhīṣmaṁ ca karṇaṁ ca balināṁ varam ॥14॥
14.61.15: spardhate sma raṇe nityaṁ duhituḥ putrako mama,
14.61.16: na tena vikr̥taṁ vaktraṁ kr̥taṁ saṅgrāmamūrdhani ॥16॥
14.61.18: eko hyekena satataṁ yudhyamāne yadi prabho ॥18॥
14.61.19: na sa śakyeta saṅgrāme nihantumapi vajriṇā,
14.61.20: tataḥ śatruvadhaṁ kr̥tvā sumahāntaṁ raṇe pitaḥ ॥20॥
14.61.21: nūnaṁ ca sa gataḥ svargaṁ jahi śokaṁ mahāmate ॥21॥
14.61.23: raṇe mahendrapratimāḥ sa kathaṁ nāpnuyād divam,
sa śokaṁ jahi durdharṣa mā ca manyuvaśaṁ gamaḥ ॥23॥
14.61.24: śastrapūtāṁ hi sa gatiṁ gataḥ parapurañjayaḥ,
tasmiṁstu nihate vīre subhadreyaṁ svasā mama ॥24॥
14.61.25: duḥkhārtātho sutaṁ prāpya kurarīva nanāda ha,
14.61.26: ārye kva dārakāḥ sarve draṣṭumicchāmi tānaham,
14.61.28: uttarāṁ cābravīd bhadre bhartā sa kva nu te gataḥ,
kṣipramāgamanaṁ mahyaṁ tasya tvaṁ vedayasva ha ॥28॥
14.61.29: nanu nāmādya vairāṭi śrutvā mama giraṁ sadā,
14.61.33: pitrā ca lālito bālaḥ sa hataḥ kāladharmaṇā ॥33॥
14.61.34: putro hi tava durdharṣaḥ samprāptaḥ paramāṁ gatim ॥34॥
14.61.36: uttarāṁ tvamavekṣasva gurviṇīṁ mā śucaḥ śubhe,
14.61.40: bhartāraṁ prati suśroṇi garbhasthaṁ rakṣa vai śiśum ॥40॥
14.61.42: evaṁ sa nidhanaṁ prāpto dauhitrastava mānada,
santāpaṁ tyaja durdharṣa mā ca śoke manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥42॥
14.61.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi vasudevasāntvane ekaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥61॥
14.62.9: kukṣistha eva tasyātha garbho vai sampralīyata ॥9॥
14.62.10: ājagāma tato vyāso jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā,
14.62.15: vicāryamatra na hi te satyametad bhaviṣyati ॥15॥
14.62.16: puroktaṁ tat tathā bhāvi mā te’trāstu vicāraṇā ॥16॥
14.62.17: na sa śocyastvayā vīro na cānyaiḥ kurubhistathā ॥17॥
14.62.19: pitāpi tava dharmajña garbhe tasmin mahāmate,
14.62.21: dharmarājo’pi medhāvī śrutvā vyāsasya tad vacaḥ,
14.62.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi vāsudevasāntvane dviṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥62॥
14.63.1: aśvamedhaṁ prati tadā kiṁ bhūyaḥ pracakāra ha ॥1॥
14.63.2: tadavāpa kathaṁ ceti tanme brūhi dvijottama ॥2॥
14.63.4: śrutaṁ vo vacanaṁ vīrāḥ sauhr̥dād yanmahātmanā ॥4॥
14.63.6: bhīṣmeṇa ca mahāprājñā govindena ca dhīmatā ॥6॥
14.63.7: āyatyāṁ ca tadātve ca sarveṣāṁ taddhi no hitam ॥7॥
14.63.8: anubandhe ca kalyāṇaṁ yad vaco brahmavādinaḥ,
iyaṁ hi vasudhā sarvā kṣīṇaratnā kurūdvahāḥ ॥8॥
14.63.9: taccācaṣṭa tadā vyāso maruttasya dhanaṁ nr̥pāḥ,
yadyetad vo bahumataṁ manyadhvaṁ vā kṣamaṁ yadi ॥9॥
14.63.10: tathā yathā’’ha dharmeṇa kathaṁ vā bhīma manyase,
14.63.11: rocate me mahābāho yadidaṁ bhāṣitaṁ tvayā ॥11॥
14.63.15: rakṣante ye ca tad dravyaṁ kinnarā raudradarśanāḥ ॥15॥
14.63.16: te ca vaśyā bhaviṣyanti prasanne vr̥ṣabhadhvaje,
14.63.16d1: sa hi devaḥ prasannātmā bhaktānāṁ parameśvaraḥ,
dadātyamaratāṁ cāpi kiṁ punaḥ kāñcanaṁ prabhuḥ.
14.63.16d3: vayaṁ sarve ca tadbhaktāḥ sa cāsmākaṁ prasīdati,
14.63.19: tato yayuḥ pāṇḍusutā brāhmaṇān svasti vācya ca,
14.63.23: dhr̥tarāṣṭraṁ sabhāryaṁ vai pr̥thāṁ ca pr̥thulocanām ॥23॥
14.63.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi dravyānayanopakrame triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥63॥
14.64.7: tasmin deśe ca rājendra yatra tad dravyamuttamam,
cakre niveśanaṁ rājā pāṇḍavaḥ saha sainikaiḥ,
śive deśe same caiva tadā bharatasattama ॥7॥
14.64.11: asmin kārye dvijaśreṣṭhā nakṣatre divase śubhe ॥11॥
14.64.12: yathā bhavanto manyante kartumarhanti tat tathā,
na naḥ kālātyayo vai syādihaiva parilambatām ॥12॥
14.64.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi dravyānayanopakrame catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥64॥
14.65.2: śrutvā tu vacanaṁ teṣāṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
14.65.3: mantrasiddhaṁ caruṁ kr̥tvā purodhāḥ sa yayau tadā ॥3॥
14.65.7: tathānyeṣāṁ ca yakṣāṇāṁ bhūtānāṁ patayaśca ye,
14.65.8: brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sahasrāṇi gavāṁ dattvā tu bhūmipaḥ ॥8॥
14.65.10: kr̥tvā pūjāṁ tu rudrasya gaṇānāṁ caiva sarvaśaḥ ॥10॥
14.65.11: yayau vyāsaṁ puraskr̥tya nr̥po ratnanidhiṁ prati,
14.65.13: arcayitvā dvijāgryān sa svasti vācya ca vīryavān,
14.65.14: prītimān sa kuruśreṣṭhaḥ khānayāmāsa tad dhanam,
14.65.19: kharāṇāṁ puruṣāṇāṁ ca parisaṅkhyā na vidyate ॥19॥
14.65.21: mahādevaṁ prati yayau puraṁ nāgāhvayaṁ prati ॥21॥
14.65.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi dravyānayane pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥65॥
14.66.8: jajñe tava pitā rājan parikṣit paravīrahā ॥8॥
14.66.13: pr̥ṣṭhato draupadīṁ caiva subhadrāṁ ca yaśasvinīm,
14.66.15: tvaṁ no gatiḥ pratiṣṭhā ca tvadāyattamidaṁ kulam ॥15॥
14.66.18: uttarāṁ ca subhadrāṁ ca draupadīṁ māṁ ca mādhava ॥18॥
14.66.19: dharmaputraṁ ca bhīmaṁ ca phālgunaṁ nakulaṁ tathā,
14.66.20: pāṇḍośca piṇḍo dāśārha tathaiva śvaśurasya me ॥20॥
14.66.21: abhimanyośca bhadraṁ te priyasya sadr̥śasya ca,
14.66.23: mātulasya kulaṁ bhadre tava putro gamiṣyati ॥23॥
14.66.24: astrāṇi ca vicitrāṇi nītiśāstraṁ ca kevalam ॥24॥
14.66.27: ucchritya bāhū duḥkhārtā tāścānyāḥ prāpatan bhuvi ॥27॥
14.66.28: svasrīyo vāsudevasya mr̥to jāta iti prabho ॥28॥
14.66.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi parīkṣijjanmakathane ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥66॥
14.67.1: utthitāyāṁ pr̥thāyāṁ tu subhadrā bhrātaraṁ tadā,
14.67.2: puṇḍarīkākṣa paśya tvaṁ pautraṁ pārthasya dhīmataḥ,
14.67.3: sottarāyāṁ nipatitā vijaye mayi caiva ha ॥3॥
14.67.4: seyaṁ vidīrṇe hr̥daye mayi tiṣṭhati keśava,
yanna paśyāmi durdharṣa sahaputraṁ tu taṁ prabho ॥4॥
14.67.5: kiṁ nu vakṣyati dharmātmā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
bhīmasenārjunau cāpi mādravatyāḥ sutau ca tau ॥5॥
14.67.7: abhimanyuḥ priyaḥ kr̥ṣṇa bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ,
te śrutvā kiṁ nu vakṣyanti droṇaputrāstranirjitāḥ ॥7॥
14.67.9: sāhaṁ prasādaye kr̥ṣṇa tvāmadya śirasā natā,
pr̥theyaṁ draupadī caiva tāḥ paśya puruṣottama ॥9॥
14.67.10: yadā droṇasuto garbhān pāṇḍūnāṁ hanti mādhava,
14.67.12: ityetad vacanaṁ śrutvā jānānāhaṁ balaṁ tava,
14.67.13: yadyetat tvaṁ pratiśrutya na karoṣi vacaḥ śubham,
14.67.14: abhimanyoḥ suto vīra na sañjīvati yadyayam,
jīvati tvayi durdharṣa kiṁ kariṣyāmyahaṁ tvayā ॥14॥
14.67.16: tvaṁ hi keśava dharmātmā satyavān satyavikramaḥ,
14.67.18: prabhāvajñāsmi te kr̥ṣṇa tasmāt tvāṁ yācayāmyaham,
14.67.19: svaseti vā mahābāho hataputreti vā punaḥ,
14.67.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi subhadrāvākye saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥67॥
14.68.2: vākyenaitena hi tadā taṁ janaṁ puruṣarṣabhaḥ,
14.68.3: tataḥ sa prāviśat tūrṇaṁ janmaveśma pitustava,
14.68.6: dadarśa ca sa tejasvī rakṣoghnānyapi sarvaśaḥ ॥6॥
14.68.7: tathāyuktaṁ ca tad dr̥ṣṭvā janmaveśma pitustava ॥7॥
14.68.10: sāpi bāṣpakalāṁ vācaṁ nigr̥hyāśrūṇi caiva ha ॥10॥
14.68.12: abhimanyuṁ ca māṁ caiva hatau tulyaṁ janārdana ॥12॥
14.68.13: vārṣṇeya madhuhan vīra śirasā tvāṁ prasādaye,
14.68.14: yadi sma dharmarājñā vā bhīmasenena vā punaḥ,
14.68.17: sā tvāṁ prasādya śirasā yāce śatrunibarhaṇam,
14.68.18: asmin hi bahavaḥ sādho ye mamāsan manorathāḥ,
te droṇaputreṇa hatāḥ kiṁ nu jīvāmi keśava ॥18॥
14.68.20: viphalā me kr̥tāḥ kr̥ṣṇa hr̥di sarve manorathāḥ ॥20॥
14.68.22: yaḥ pāṇḍavīṁ śriyaṁ tvaktvā gato’dya yamasādanam ॥22॥
14.68.24: idānīṁ māṁ gatāṁ tatra kiṁ nu vakṣyati phālguniḥ ॥24॥
14.68.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi uttarāvākye aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥68॥
14.69.7: putra gatvā mama vaco brūyāstvaṁ pitaraṁ tvidam,
14.69.8: yāhaṁ tvayā vinādyeha patyā putreṇa caiva ha,
14.69.9: bhakṣayiṣye viṣaṁ ghoraṁ pravekṣye vā hutāśanam ॥9॥
14.69.10: athavā durmaraṁ tāta yadidaṁ me sahasradhā,
14.69.12: āryāṁ ca paśya pāñcālīṁ sātvatīṁ ca tapasvinīm,
māṁ ca paśya suduḥkhārtāṁ vyādhaviddhāṁ mr̥gīmiva ॥12॥
14.69.14: evaṁ vipralapantīṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā nipatitāṁ punaḥ,
14.69.15: utthāya ca punardhairyāt tadā matsyapateḥ sutā,
14.69.16: śrutvā sa tasyā vipulaṁ vilāpaṁ puruṣarṣabhaḥ,
14.69.20: yathā me dayito dharmo brāhmaṇaśca viśeṣataḥ,
abhimanyoḥ suto jāto mr̥to jīvatvayaṁ tathā ॥20॥
14.69.21: virodhaṁ tena satyena mr̥to jīvatvayaṁ śiśuḥ ॥21॥
14.69.22: yathā satyaṁ ca dharmaśca mayi nityaṁ pratiṣṭhitau,
14.69.23: yathā kaṁsaśca keśī ca dharmeṇa nihatau mayā,
14.69.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi parikṣitsañjīvane ekonasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥69॥
14.70.1: brahmāstraṁ tu yadā rājan kr̥ṣṇena pratisaṁhr̥tam,
14.70.2: tato rakṣāṁsi sarvāṇi neśustyaktvā gr̥haṁ tu tat,
antarikṣe ca vāgāsīt sādhu keśava sādhviti ॥2॥
14.70.3: tataḥ prāṇān punarlebhe pitā tava nareśvara ॥3॥
14.70.6: kuntī drupadaputrī ca subhadrā cottarā tathā ॥6॥
14.70.10: tasya kr̥ṣṇo dadau hr̥ṣṭo bahuratnaṁ viśeṣataḥ,
14.70.13: māsajātastu te vīra pitā bhavati bhārata ॥13॥
14.70.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi pāṇḍavāgamane saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥70॥
14.71.2: te sametya yathādharmaṁ pāṇḍavā vr̥ṣṇibhiḥ saha ॥2॥
14.71.4: te kośānagrataḥ kr̥tvā viviśuḥ svapuraṁ tadā ॥4॥
14.71.7: viduraṁ pūjayitvā ca vaiśyāputraṁ sametya ca ॥7॥
14.71.8: pūjyamānāḥ sma te vīrā vyarocanta viśāmpate,
14.71.9: śuśruvuste tadā vīrāḥ pituste janma bhārata,
14.71.14: tvadadhīnā vayaṁ sarve kr̥ṣṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥14॥
14.71.16: teneṣṭvā tvaṁ vipāpmā vai bhavitā nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥16॥
14.71.17: ityuktaḥ sa tu dharmātmā kururājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
14.71.19: yad brūyāṁ tvāṁ mahābāho tat kr̥thāstvamihācyuta ॥19॥
14.71.20: parākrameṇa buddhyā ca tvayeyaṁ nirjitā mahī ॥20॥
14.71.21: dīkṣayasva tvamātmānaṁ tvaṁ hi naḥ paramo guruḥ,
14.71.22: tvaṁ hi yajño’kṣaraḥ sarvastvaṁ dharmastvaṁ prajāpatiḥ,
tvaṁ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāmiti me niścitā matiḥ ॥22॥
14.71.23: tvaṁ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāmiti me niścitā matiḥ ॥23॥
14.71.24: tvaṁ cādya kuruvīrāṇāṁ dharmeṇa hi virājase,
guṇībhūtāḥ sma te rājaṁstvaṁ no rājā gururmataḥ ॥24॥
14.71.25: yunaktu no bhavān kārye yatra vāñchasi bhārata ॥25॥
14.71.26: satyaṁ te pratijānāmi sarvaṁ kartāsmi te’nagha,
14.71.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇavyāsānujñāyāmekasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥71॥
14.72.2: yadā kālaṁ bhavān vetti hayamedhasya tattvataḥ,
dīkṣayasva tadā māṁ tvaṁ tvayyāyatto hi me kratuḥ ॥2॥
14.72.3: vidhānaṁ yad yathākālaṁ tat kartāro na saṁśayaḥ ॥3॥
14.72.4: caitryāṁ hi paurṇamāsyāṁ tu tava dīkṣā bhaviṣyati,
14.72.6: sa paryetu yaśo dīptaṁ tava pārthiva darśayan ॥6॥
14.72.10: yathākālaṁ yathāyogaṁ sajjāḥ sma tava dīkṣaṇe,
14.72.11: tatra yogyaṁ bhavet kiñcid raukmaṁ tat kriyatāmiti,
14.72.13: kaḥ pālayediti mune tad bhavān vaktumarhati ॥13॥
14.72.15: śaktaḥ sa hi mahīṁ jetuṁ nivātakavacāntakaḥ ॥15॥
14.72.16: tasmin hyastrāṇi divyāni divyaṁ saṁhananaṁ tathā,
14.72.18: abhimanyoḥ pitā vīraḥ sa enaṁ pālayiṣyati ॥18॥
14.72.21: cakāra phālgunaṁ cāpi sandideśa hayaṁ prati ॥21॥
14.72.22: tvamarho rakṣituṁ hyenaṁ nānyaḥ kaścana mānavaḥ ॥22॥
14.72.23: ye cāpi tvāṁ mahābāho pratyudyānti narādhipāḥ,
tairvigraho yathā na syāt tathā kāryaṁ tvayānagha ॥23॥
14.72.25: bhīmaṁ ca nakulaṁ caiva puraguptau samādadhat ॥25॥
14.72.26: kuṭumbatantre ca tadā sahadevaṁ yudhāṁ patim,
14.72.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi yajñasāmagrīsampādane dvisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥72॥
14.73.4: sa rājā dharmarāḍ rājan dīkṣito vibabhau tadā,
14.73.8: tamaśvaṁ pr̥thivīpāla mudā yuktaḥ sasāra ca ॥8॥
14.73.10: didr̥kṣūṇāṁ hayaṁ taṁ ca taṁ caiva hayasāriṇam ॥10॥
14.73.11: tataḥ śabdo mahārāja diśaḥ khaṁ prati pūrayan,
14.73.20: cacāra sa mahārāja yathādeśaṁ ca sattama ॥20॥
14.73.21: tatra yuddhāni vr̥ttāni yānyāsan pāṇḍavasya ha,
tāni vakṣyāmi te vīra vicitrāṇi mahānti ca ॥21॥
14.73.25: mlecchāścānye bahuvidhāḥ pūrvaṁ ye nikr̥tā raṇe ॥25॥
14.73.27: evaṁ vr̥ttāni yuddhāni tatra tatra mahīpate,
14.73.28: yāni tūbhayato rājan prataptāni mahānti ca,
14.73.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi aśvānusaraṇe trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥73॥
14.74.4: tataḥ kirīṭī sañcintya teṣāṁ tatra cikīrṣitam,
14.74.7: sa hi vīraḥ prayāsyan vai dharmarājena vāritaḥ,
hatabāndhavā na te pārtha hantavyāḥ pārthivā iti ॥7॥
14.74.8: sa tadā tad vacaḥ śrutvā dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ,
tān nivartadhvamityāha na nyavartanta cāpi te ॥8॥
14.74.18: na sandadhānaṁ dadr̥śe nādadānaṁ ca taṁ tadā,
14.74.19: manasā tu muhūrtaṁ vai raṇe samabhiharṣayan ॥19॥
14.74.21: dhr̥tavarmā śaraṁ dīptaṁ mumoca vijaye tadā ॥21॥
14.74.22: sa tena vijayastūrṇamāsīd viddhāḥ kare bhr̥śam,
mumoca gāṇḍivaṁ mohāt tat papātātha bhūtale ॥22॥
14.74.25: tato roṣārdito jiṣṇuḥ pramr̥jya rudhiraṁ karāt,
14.74.29: tato yodhān jaghānāśu teṣāṁ sa daśa cāṣṭa ca,
14.74.32: tavāsma kiṅkarāḥ sarve sarve vai vaśagāstava ॥32॥
14.74.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi trigartaparābhave catuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥74॥
14.75.6: punaḥ praviśya nagaraṁ daṁśitaḥ sa nr̥pottamaḥ,
14.75.14: dvidhā tridhā ca ciccheda kha eva khagamaistadā ॥14॥
14.75.15: sa tān dr̥ṣṭvā tathā chinnāṁstomarān bhagadattajaḥ,
14.75.20: sa tairviddho mahānāgo visravan rudhiraṁ vabhau,
14.75.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi vajradattayuddhe pañcasaptatimo’dhyāyaḥ ॥75॥
14.76.3: arjunārjuna tiṣṭhasva na me jīvan vimokṣyase,
14.76.4: tvayā vr̥ddho mama pitā bhagadattaḥ pituḥ sakhā,
hato vr̥ddho mama pitā śiśuṁ māmadya yodhaya ॥4॥
14.76.8: sa tena preṣito rājñā meghavad vinadan muhuḥ,
14.76.18: sa tena vāraṇo rājan marmasvabhihato bhr̥śam,
14.76.20: taṁ na bhetavyamityāha tato bhūmigataṁ nr̥pam ॥20॥
14.76.22: yodhāścāpi na hantavyā dhanañjaya raṇe tvayā ॥22॥
14.76.24: iti bhrātr̥vacaḥ śrutvā na hanmi tvāṁ narādhipa,
uttiṣṭha na bhayaṁ te’sti svastimān gaccha pārthiva ॥24॥
14.76.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi vajradattaparājaye ṣaṭsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥76॥
14.77.0d1: visr̥jya yāte turage saindhavān prati bhārata.
14.77.3: aśvaṁ ca taṁ parāmr̥śya viṣayānte viṣopamāḥ,
14.77.6: te nāmānyapi gotrāṇi karmāṇi vividhāni ca,
14.77.11: taṁ smaranto vadhaṁ vīrāḥ sindhurājasya cāhave,
14.77.12: taiḥ kīrṇaḥ śuśubhe pārtho ravirmeghāntare yathā ॥12॥
14.77.24: tato devarṣayaḥ sarve tathā saptarṣayo’pi ca,
14.77.27: tataḥ sa śaravarṣāṇi pratyamitrān prati prabhuḥ,
14.77.28: tataste saindhavā yodhāḥ sarva eva sarājakāḥ,
14.77.31: visr̥jya dikṣu sarvāsu mahendra iva vajrabhr̥t ॥31॥
14.77.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi saindhavayuddhe saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥77॥
14.78.3: tataḥ provāca kaunteyo mumūrṣūn ślakṣṇayā girā,
yudhyadhvaṁ parayā śaktyā yatadhvaṁ vijaye mama ॥3॥
14.78.6: na hantavyā raṇe tāta kṣatriyā vijigīṣavaḥ ॥6॥
14.78.8: ityukto’haṁ narendreṇa na hantavyā nr̥pā iti,
kathaṁ tanna mr̥ṣedaṁ syād dharmarājavacaḥ śubham ॥8॥
14.78.9: na hanyeraṁśca rājāno rājñaścājñā kr̥tā bhavet,
iti sañcintya sa tadā phālgunaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥9॥
14.78.12: evamuktvā tu tān vīrān yuyudhe kurupuṅgavaḥ ॥12॥
14.78.15: chittvā tu tānāśu caiva kaṅkapatrān śilāśitān ॥15॥
14.78.17: jayadrathaṁ hataṁ smr̥tvā cikṣipuḥ saindhavā nr̥pāḥ,
teṣāṁ kirīṭī saṅkalpaṁ moghaṁ cakre mahābalaḥ ॥17॥
14.78.25: samutsr̥jya dhanuḥ pārtho vidhivad bhaginīṁ tadā ॥25॥
14.78.26: prāha kiṁ karavāṇīti sā ca taṁ pratyuvāca ha,
14.78.29: sa pūrvaṁ pitaraṁ śrutvā hataṁ yuddhe tvayānagha ॥29॥
14.78.32: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā patitaṁ tatra tatastasyātmajaṁ prabho,
14.78.35: vismr̥tya kururājānaṁ taṁ ca mandaṁ jayadratham,
14.78.37: śamārthaṁ sarvayodhānāṁ śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vaco mama,
14.78.39: yācate tvāṁ mahābāho śamaṁ gaccha dhanañjaya,
14.78.42: saṁsmr̥tya devīṁ gāndhārīṁ dhr̥tarāṣṭraṁ ca pārthivam,
14.78.43: yaskr̥te bāndhavāḥ sarve mayā nītā yamakṣayam,
14.78.44: pariṣvajya ca tāṁ prīto visasarja gr̥hān prati ॥44॥
14.78.45: duḥśalā cāpi tān yodhān nivārya mahato raṇāt,
14.78.46: evaṁ nirjitya tān vīrān saindhavān sa dhanañjayaḥ,
14.78.47: sasāra taṁ tathā vīro vidhivad yajñiyaṁ hayam ॥47॥
14.78.48: sa ca vājī yatheṣṭena tāṁstān deśān yathākramam,
14.78.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi saindhavaparājaye aṣṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥78॥
14.79.1: śrutvā tu nr̥patiḥ prāptaṁ pitaraṁ babhruvāhanaḥ,
14.79.3: uvāca ca sa dharmātmā samanyuḥ phālgunastadā,
prakriyeyaṁ na te yuktā bahistvaṁ kṣatradharmataḥ ॥3॥
14.79.4: yajñiyaṁ viṣayānte māṁ nāyautsīḥ kiṁ nu putraka ॥4॥
14.79.5: yo māṁ yuddhāya samprāptaṁ sāmnaiva pratyagr̥hṇathāḥ ॥5॥
14.79.6: na tvayā puruṣārtho hi kaścidastīha jīvatā,
yastvaṁ strīvad yathāprāptaṁ māṁ sāmnā pratyagr̥hṇathāḥ ॥6॥
14.79.7: prakriyeyaṁ bhaved yuktā tāvat tava narādhama ॥7॥
14.79.11: ulūpīṁ māṁ nibodha tvaṁ mātaraṁ pannagātmajām,
kuruṣva vacanaṁ putra dharmaste bhavitā paraḥ ॥11॥
14.79.12: evameṣa hi te prīto bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ॥12॥
14.79.13: evaṁ durmarṣito rājā sa mātrā babhruvāhanaḥ,
14.79.14: saṁnahya kāñcanaṁ varma śirastrāṇaṁ ca bhānumat,
14.79.18: gr̥hītaṁ vājinaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā prītātmā sa dhanañjayaḥ,
14.79.19: sa tatra rājā taṁ vīraṁ śarasaṅghairanekaśaḥ,
14.79.20: tayoḥ samabhavad yuddhaṁ pituḥ putrasya cātulam,
14.79.23: divyaṁ tejaḥ samāviśya pramīta iva so’bhavat ॥23॥
14.79.25: sadr̥śaṁ karma te dr̥ṣṭvā prītimānasmi putraka ॥25॥
14.79.26: vimuñcāmyeṣa te bāṇān putra yuddhe sthiro bhava,
14.79.33: tataḥ sa bālyāt pitaraṁ vivyādha hr̥di patriṇā,
14.79.36: vyāyamya saṁyuge rājā dr̥ṣṭvā ca pitaraṁ hatam ॥36॥
14.79.38: bhartāraṁ nihataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā putraṁ ca patitaṁ bhuvi,
14.79.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi arjunababhruvāhanayuddhe ekonāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥79॥
14.80.2: pratilabhya ca sā sañjñāṁ devī divyavapurdharā,
14.80.3: ulūpi paśya bhartāraṁ śayānaṁ nihataṁ raṇe,
14.80.10: nanu tvayā nāma vibho dharmarājasya yajñiyaḥ,
14.80.12: ulūpi sādhu paśyemaṁ patiṁ nipatitaṁ bhuvi,
putraṁ cemaṁ samutsādya ghātayitvā na śocasi ॥12॥
14.80.13: kāmaṁ svapitu bālo’yaṁ bhūmau mr̥tyuvaśaṁ gataḥ,
14.80.15: sakhyaṁ caitat kr̥taṁ dhātrā śaśvadavyayameva tu,
14.80.16: putreṇa ghātayitvainaṁ patiṁ yadi na me’dya vai,
14.80.19: tato vilapya viratā bhartuḥ pādau pragr̥hya sā,
14.80.20: tataḥ sañjñāṁ punarlabdhvā sa rājā babhruvāhanaḥ,
14.80.21: ito duḥkhataraṁ kiṁ nu yanme mātā sukhaidhitā,
14.80.22: mayā vinihataṁ saṅkhye prekṣate durmaraṁ bata ॥22॥
14.80.23: aho’syā hr̥dayaṁ devyā dr̥ḍhaṁ yanna vidīryate,
14.80.24: yatra nāhaṁ na me mātā viprayujyeta jīvitāt ॥24॥
14.80.25: hā hā dhik kuruvīrasya saṁnāhaṁ kāñcanaṁ bhuvi,
14.80.26: bho bho paśyata me vīraṁ pitaraṁ brāhmaṇā bhuvi,
14.80.27: kurvanti śāntiṁ kāmasya raṇe yo’yaṁ mayā hataḥ ॥27॥
14.80.28: vyādiśantu ca kiṁ viprāḥ prāyaścittamihādya me,
14.80.31: kr̥taṁ priyaṁ mayā te’dya nihatya samare’rjunam ॥31॥
14.80.33: sā tvaṁ mayi mr̥te mātastathā gāṇḍīvadhanvani,
14.80.35: tvaṁ ca mātaryathā satyaṁ bravīmi bhujagottame ॥35॥
14.80.36: yadi nottiṣṭhati jayaḥ pitā me narasattamaḥ,
14.80.37: na hi me pitaraṁ hatvā niṣkr̥tirvidyate kvacit,
14.80.38: vīraṁ hi kṣatriyaṁ hatvā gośatena pramucyate,
14.80.39: pitā ca mama dharmātmā tasya me niṣkr̥tiḥ kutaḥ ॥39॥
14.80.43: taṁ gr̥hītvā tu kauravya nāgarājapateḥ sutā,
14.80.44: uttiṣṭha mā śucaḥ putra naiva viṣṇustvayā jitaḥ,
14.80.45: mayā tu mohanī nāma māyaiṣā sampradarśitā,
14.80.47: mā pāpamātmanaḥ putra śaṅkethā hyaṇvapi prabho ॥47॥
14.80.48: nainaṁ śakto hi saṅgrāme jetuṁ śakro’pi putraka ॥48॥
14.80.49: ayaṁ tu me maṇirdivyaḥ samānīto viśāmpate,
mr̥tān mr̥tān pannagendrān yo jīvayati nityadā ॥49॥
14.80.50: enamasyorasi tvaṁ ca sthāpayasva pituḥ prabho,
sañjīvitaṁ tadā pārthaṁ sa tvaṁ draṣṭāsi pāṇḍavam ॥50॥
14.80.52: tasmin nyaste maṇau vīro jiṣṇurujjīvitaḥ prabhuḥ,
14.80.55: sādhu sādhviti cākāśe babhūva sumahān svanaḥ ॥55॥
14.80.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi aśvānusaraṇe arjunapratyujjīvane aśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥80॥
14.81.2: mama vā capalāpāṅgi kaccit tvaṁ śubhamicchasi ॥2॥
14.81.5: na me tvamaparāddho’si na hi me babhruvāhanaḥ ॥5॥
14.81.6: na janitrī tathāsyeyaṁ mama yā preṣyavat sthitā,
śrūyatāṁ yad yathā cedaṁ mayā sarvaṁ viceṣṭitam ॥6॥
14.81.7: na me kopastvayā kāryaḥ śirasā tvāṁ prasādaye,
14.81.9: adharmeṇa hataḥ pārtha tasyaiṣā niṣkr̥tiḥ kr̥tā,
na hi bhīṣmastvayā vīra yuddhyamāno hi pātitaḥ ॥9॥
14.81.10: tasya śāntimakr̥tvā tvaṁ tyajethā yadi jīvitam ॥10॥
14.81.11: karmaṇā tena pāpena patethā niraye dhruvam,
eṣā tu vihitā śāntiḥ putrād yāṁ prāptavānasi,
14.81.12: purā hi śrutametat te vasubhiḥ kathitaṁ mayā,
14.81.13: āplutya devā vasavaḥ sametya ca mahānadīm,
14.81.16: abhavaṁ sa ca tacchrutvā viṣādamagamat param,
pitā tu me vasūn gatvā tvadarthe samayācata ॥16॥
14.81.18: sa enaṁ raṇamadhyasthaḥ śaraiḥ pātayitā bhuvi,
evaṁ kr̥te sa nāgendra muktaśāpo bhaviṣyati ॥18॥
14.81.19: gaccheti vasubhiścokto mama cedaṁ śaśaṁsa saḥ,
14.81.20: na hi tvāṁ devarājo’pi samareṣu parājayet,
14.81.21: na hi doṣo mama mataḥ kathaṁ vā manyase vibho,
14.81.22: sarvaṁ me supriyaṁ devi yadetat kr̥tavatyasi,
14.81.27: bhāryābhyāṁ saha dharmajña mā bhūt te’tra vicāraṇā ॥27॥
14.81.29: ityuktaḥ sa tu putreṇa tadā vānaraketanaḥ,
14.81.30: viditaṁ te mahābāho yathā dīkṣāṁ carāmyaham,
na sa tāvat pravekṣyāmi puraṁ te pr̥thulocana ॥30॥
14.81.31: svasti te’stu gamiṣyāmi na sthānaṁ vidyate mama ॥31॥
14.81.32: sa tatra vidhivat tena pūjitaḥ pākaśāsaniḥ,
14.81.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi aśvānusaraṇe ekāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥81॥
14.82.1: sa tu vājī samudrāntāṁ paryetya vasudhāmimām,
14.82.4: tataḥ purāt sa niṣkramya rathī dhanvī śarī talī,
14.82.6: kimayaṁ cāryate vājī strīmadhya iva bhārata,
14.82.8: vighnakartā mayā vārya iti me vratamāhitam ॥8॥
14.82.9: bhrātrā jyeṣṭhena nr̥pate tavāpi viditaṁ dhruvam,
14.82.12: sa moghaṁ tasya bāṇaughaṁ kr̥tvā vānaraketanaḥ,
14.82.13: dhvaje patākādaṇḍeṣu rathe yantre hayeṣu ca,
anyeṣu ca rathāṅgeṣu na śarīre na sārathau ॥13॥
14.82.16: tena tasthau sa kauravya lokavīrasya darśane ॥16॥
14.82.17: savyasācī tu saṅkruddho vikr̥ṣya balavad dhanuḥ,
14.82.18: hastāvāpaṁ patākāṁ ca dhvajaṁ cāsya nyapātayat ॥18॥
14.82.23: bahvetat samare karma tava bālasya pārthiva ॥23॥
14.82.24: yudhiṣṭhirasya sandeśo na hantavyā nr̥pā iti,
14.82.25: iti matvā tadātmānaṁ pratyādiṣṭaṁ sma māgadhaḥ,
14.82.26: yad yat kr̥tyaṁ mayā te’dya tad brūhi kr̥tameva tu ॥26॥
14.82.28: ityuktaḥ sa tathetyuktvā pūjayāmāsa tam iyam,
phālgunaṁ ca yudhi śreṣṭhaṁ vidhivat sahadevajaḥ ॥28॥
14.82.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi aśvānusaraṇe māgadhaparājaye dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥82॥
14.83.2: tataḥ sa punarāvartya hayaḥ kāmacaro balī,
14.83.3: yuddhapūrvaṁ tadā tena pūjayā ca mahābalaḥ ॥3॥
14.83.8: tatra cakre niṣādaiḥ sa saṅgrāmaṁ lomaharṣaṇam ॥8॥
14.83.10: sa taṁ jitvā mahārāja naiṣādiṁ pākaśāsaniḥ,
14.83.18: tataḥ sa paścimaṁ deśaṁ samudrasya tadā hayaḥ,
krameṇa vyacarat sphītaṁ tataḥ pañcanadaṁ yayau ॥18॥
14.83.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi aśvānusaraṇe tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥83॥
14.84.4: yudhiṣṭhirasya vacanaṁ na ca te jagr̥hurhitam,
14.84.9: sa rājā śakuneḥ putraḥ pāṇḍavaṁ pratyavārayat,
14.84.10: alaṁ yuddhena te vīra na te’stvadya parājayaḥ ॥10॥
14.84.13: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vismayaṁ jagmurgāndhārāḥ sarva eva te,
icchatā tena na hato rājetyasi ca taṁ viduḥ ॥13॥
14.84.22: na me priyaṁ mahābāho yatte buddhiriyaṁ kr̥tā,
14.84.24: maivaṁ bhūḥ śāmyatāṁ vairaṁ mā te bhūd buddhirīdr̥śī,
14.84.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi aśvānusaraṇe śakuniputraparājaye caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥84॥
14.85.1: nyavartata tato vājī yena nāgāhvayaṁ puram ॥1॥
14.85.2: taṁ nivr̥ttaṁ tu śuśrāva cāreṇaiva yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
14.85.3: vijayasya ca tat karma gāndhāraviṣaye tadā,
śrutvā cānyeṣu deśeṣu sa suprīto’bhavat tadā ॥3॥
14.85.5: bhīmaṁ ca nakulaṁ caiva sahadevaṁ ca kaurava ॥5॥
14.85.6: provācedaṁ vacaḥ kāle tadā dharmabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
āmantrya vadatāṁ śreṣṭho bhīmaṁ praharatāṁ varam ॥6॥
14.85.8: māghī ca paurṇamāsīyaṁ māsaḥ śeṣo vr̥kodara ॥8॥
14.85.10: ityuktaḥ sa tu taccakre bhīmo nr̥patiśāsanam,
14.85.11: tato yayau bhīmasenaḥ prājñaiḥ sthapatibhiḥ saha,
14.85.25: tataḥ kr̥tvā sthapatayaḥ śilpino’nye ca ye tadā,
14.85.27: tasmin yajñe pravr̥tte tu vāgmino hetuvādinaḥ,
14.85.32: sthalajā jalajā ye ca paśavaḥ kecana prabho,
14.85.33: audakāni ca sattvāni śvāpadāni vayāṁsi ca ॥33॥
14.85.36: pūrṇe śatasahasre tu viprāṇāṁ tatra bhuñjatām ॥36॥
14.85.38: evaṁ sa vavr̥te yajño dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ,
14.85.42: te vai nr̥popabhojyāni brāhmaṇānāṁ daduśca ha ॥42॥
14.85.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi aśvamedhārambhe pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥85॥
14.86.2: eteṣāṁ kriyatāṁ pūjā pūjārhā hi narādhipāḥ ॥2॥
14.86.3: ityuktaḥ sa tathā cakre narendreṇa yaśasvinā,
14.86.6: teṣāmapi parāṁ pūjāṁ cakre bhīmo mahārathaḥ,
viviśuste ca veśmāni ratnavanti ca sarvaśaḥ ॥6॥
14.86.8: sa taṁ papraccha kaunteyaḥ punaḥ punararindamam,
14.86.10: samīpe ca mahābāhumācaṣṭa ca mama prabho,
14.86.11: diṣṭyā sa kuśalī jiṣṇurupāyāti ca mādhava ॥11॥
14.86.14: vācyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ kr̥ṣṇa kāle vākyamidaṁ mama ॥14॥
14.86.15: prāptānāṁ mahatāṁ pūjā kāryā hyetat kṣamaṁ hi naḥ ॥15॥
14.86.20: sa tu bhakto’nuraktaśca mama nityamiti prabho ॥20॥
14.86.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi aśvamedhārambhe ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥86॥
14.87.1: śrutaṁ priyamidaṁ kr̥ṣṇa yat tvamarhasi bhāṣitum,
14.87.2: punarāsan hr̥ṣīkeśa tatra tatra ca me śrutam ॥2॥
14.87.3: kiṁ nimittaṁ sa nityaṁ hi pārthaḥ sukhavivarjitaḥ,
atīva vijayo dhīmanniti me dūyate manaḥ ॥3॥
14.87.6: na hi paśyāmi bībhatsornindyaṁ gātreṣu kiñcana,
14.87.11: kr̥ṣṇā tu draupadī kr̥ṣṇaṁ tiryak sāsūyamaikṣata,
14.87.12: tatra bhīmādayaste tu kuravo yājakāśca ye ॥12॥
14.87.13: remuḥ śrutvā vicitrāṁ tāṁ dhanañjayakathāṁ śubhām,
14.87.16: tato dvitīye divase mahān śabdo vyavardhata ॥16॥
14.87.17: tato reṇuḥ samudbhūto vibabhau tasya vājinaḥ ॥17॥
14.87.19: diṣṭyāsi pārtha kuśalī dhanyo rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
ko’nyo hi pr̥thivīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ jitvā hi yudhi pārthivān ॥19॥
14.87.22: ityevaṁ vadatāṁ teṣāṁ puṁsāṁ karṇasukhā giraḥ ॥22॥
14.87.26: etasminneva kāle tu sa rājā babhruvāhanaḥ ॥26॥
14.87.27: mātr̥bhyāṁ sahito dhīmān kurūneva jagāma ha,
tatra vr̥ddhān yathāvat sa kurūnanyāṁśca pārthivān ॥27॥
14.87.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi arjunapratyāgamane saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥87॥
14.88.3: dadau kuntī tatastābhyāṁ ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥3॥
14.88.4: draupadī ca subhadrā ca yāścāpyanyā’daduḥ striyaḥ,
14.88.5: sa ca rājā mahātejāḥ pūjito babhruvāhanaḥ ॥5॥
14.88.7: sa taiḥ premṇā pariṣvaktaḥ pūjitaśca yathāvidhi ॥7॥
14.88.11: pr̥thak pr̥thak ca te cainaṁ mānārthābhyāmayojayan,
14.88.12: adyaprabhr̥ti kaunteya yajasva samayo hi te,
14.88.13: ahīno nāma rājendra kratuste’yaṁ ca kalpatām,
14.88.14: tritvaṁ vrajatu te rājan brāhmaṇā hyātra kāraṇam ॥14॥
14.88.20: kramamuktaṁ ca yuktaṁ ca cakrustatra dvijarṣabhāḥ ॥20॥
14.88.23: na tatra kr̥paṇaḥ kaścinna daridro babhūva ha,
kṣudhito duḥkhito vāpi prākr̥to vāpi mānavaḥ ॥23॥
14.88.27: tato yūpocchraye prāpte ṣaḍ bailvān bharatarṣabha,
14.88.33: taṁ taṁ devaṁ samuddiśya pakṣiṇaḥ paśavaśca ye ॥33॥
14.88.35: yūpeṣu niyatā cāsīt paśūnāṁ triśatī tathā,
14.88.36: sa yajñaḥ śuśubhe tasya sākṣād devarṣisaṅkulaḥ,
14.88.40: ramayanti sma tān viprān yajñakarmāntareṣu vai ॥40॥
14.88.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi aśvamedhārambhe aṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥88॥
14.89.3: uddhr̥tya tu vapāṁ tasya yathāśāstraṁ dvijātayaḥ ॥3॥
14.89.7: vyāsaḥ saśiṣyo bhagavān vardhayāmāsa taṁ nr̥pam,
14.89.8: koṭīḥ sahasraṁ niṣkāṇāṁ vyāsāya tu vasundharām,
14.89.10: niṣkrayo dīyatāṁ mahyaṁ brāhmaṇā hi dhanārthinaḥ,
14.89.11: bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahito dhīmān madhye rājñāṁ mahātmanām,
14.89.14: idaṁ nityaṁ mano viprā bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ caiva me sadā,
ityuktavati tasmiṁstu bhrātaro draupadī ca sā ॥14॥
14.89.17: dattaiṣā bhavatā mahyaṁ tāṁ te pratidadāmyaham ॥17॥
14.89.19: ityuktaḥ sa kuruśreṣṭhaḥ prītātmā bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha ॥19॥
14.89.21: pratigr̥hya tu tad ratnaṁ kr̥ṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ ॥21॥
14.89.24: yajñavāṭe ca yat kiñcid hiraṇyaṁ savibhūṣaṇam ॥24॥
14.89.28: svamaṁśaṁ bhagavān vyāsaḥ kuntyai sākṣāddhi mānataḥ,
14.89.29: śvaśurāt prītidāyaṁ taṁ prāpya sā prītamānasā,
cakāra puṇyakaṁ tena sumahat saṅghaśaḥ pr̥thā ॥29॥
14.89.30: gatvā tvavabhr̥thaṁ rājā vipāpmā bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha,
14.89.32: rājabhyo’pi tataḥ prādād ratnāni vividhāni ca,
14.89.34: ānīya ca tathā vīraṁ rājānaṁ babhruvāhanam,
pradāya vipulaṁ vittaṁ gr̥hān prāsthāpayat tadā ॥34॥
14.89.39: evaṁ babhūva yajñaḥ sa dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ,
14.89.41: paśūnāṁ badhyatāṁ caiva nāntaṁ dadr̥śire janāḥ ॥41॥
14.89.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi aśvamedhasamāptau ekonanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥89॥
14.90.6: mānuṣaṁ vacanaṁ prāha dhr̥ṣṭo bilaśayo mahān ॥6॥
14.90.8: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā nakulasya viśāmpate,
vismayaṁ paramaṁ jagmuḥ sarve te brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ ॥8॥
14.90.9: tataḥ sametya nakulaṁ paryapr̥cchanta te dvijāḥ,
14.90.10: kiṁ balaṁ paramaṁ tubhyaṁ kiṁ śrutaṁ kiṁ parāyaṇam,
kathaṁ bhavantaṁ vidyāma yo no yajñaṁ vigarhase ॥10॥
14.90.11: yathāgamaṁ yathānyāyaṁ kartavyaṁ ca tathā kr̥tam ॥11॥
14.90.16: yadatra tathyaṁ tad brūhi satyaṁ satyaṁ dvijātiṣu,
14.90.17: śraddheyavākyaḥ prājñastvaṁ divyaṁ rūpaṁ bibharṣi ca,
14.90.18: iti pr̥ṣṭo dvijaistaiḥ sa prahasan nakulo’bravīt,
naiṣā mr̥ṣā mayā vāṇī proktā darpeṇa vā dvijāḥ ॥18॥
14.90.22: svargaṁ yena dvijāḥ prāptaḥ sabhāryaḥ sasutasnuṣaḥ,
14.90.26: ṣaṣṭhe kāle sadā vipro bhuṅkte taiḥ saha suvrataḥ,
ṣaṣṭhe kāle kadācit tu tasyāhāro na vidyate ॥26॥
14.90.27: bhuṅkte’nyasmin kadācit sa ṣaṣṭhe kāle dvijottamaḥ,
14.90.29: kāle kāle’sya samprāpte naiva vidyeta bhojanam,
kṣudhāparigatāḥ sarve prātiṣṭhanta tadā tu te ॥29॥
14.90.30: uñchaṁ tadā śuklapakṣe madhyaṁ tapati bhāskare,
14.90.31: sa tathaiva kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ sārdhaṁ parijanena ha ॥31॥
14.90.37: sa brahmacaryaṁ gotraṁ te tasya khyātvā parasparam ॥37॥
14.90.38: idamarghyaṁ ca pādyaṁ ca br̥sī ceyaṁ tavānagha ॥38॥
14.90.39: pratigr̥hṇīṣva bhadraṁ te mayā dattā dvijarṣabha ॥39॥
14.90.40: bhakṣayāmāsa rājendra na ca tuṣṭiṁ jagāma saḥ ॥40॥
14.90.43: iti bruvantīṁ tāṁ sādhvīṁ bhāryāṁ sa dvijasattamaḥ,
14.90.44: jānan vr̥ddhāṁ kṣudhārtāṁ ca śrāntāṁ glānāṁ tapasvinīm ॥44॥
14.90.46: striyo rakṣyāśca poṣyāśca na tvevaṁ vaktumarhasi,
anukampyo naraḥ patnyā puṣṭo rakṣita eva ca ॥46॥
14.90.47: prapated yaśaso dīptāt sa ca lokān na cāpnuyāt,
14.90.48: na vetti karmato bhāryārakṣaṇe yo’kṣamaḥ pumān ॥48॥
14.90.49: ityuktā sā tataḥ prāha dharmārthau nau samau dvija ॥49॥
14.90.52: pālanāddhi patistvaṁ me bhartāsi bharaṇācca me ॥52॥
14.90.54: ityuktaḥ sa tayā saktūn pragr̥hyedaṁ vaco’bravīt ॥54॥
14.90.55: sa tān pragr̥hya bhuktvā ca na tuṣṭimagamad dvijaḥ,
14.90.56: saktūnimān pragr̥hya tvaṁ dehi viprāya sattama,
14.90.57: bhavān hi paripālyo me sarvadaiva prayatnataḥ,
14.90.58: śrutireṣā hi viprarṣe triṣu lokeṣu śāśvatī ॥58॥
14.90.59: prāṇo hi paramo dharmaḥ sthito deheṣu dehinām ॥59॥
14.90.60: api varṣasahasrī tvaṁ bāla eva mato mama,
utpādya putraṁ hi pitā kr̥takr̥tyo bhavet sutāt ॥60॥
14.90.61: vr̥ddho’haṁ dhārayiṣyāmi tvaṁ balī bhava putraka ॥61॥
14.90.62: jīrṇena vayasā putra na māṁ kṣud bādhate’pi ca,
dīrghakālaṁ tapastaptaṁ na me maraṇato bhayam ॥62॥
14.90.63: apatyamasmi te puṁsastrāṇāt putra iti smr̥taḥ,
14.90.64: rūpeṇa sadr̥śastvaṁ me śīlena ca damena ca,
14.90.65: prahasanniva viprāya sa tasmai pradadau tadā ॥65॥
14.90.66: bhuktvā tānapi saktūn sa naiva tuṣṭo babhūva ha,
14.90.67: taṁ vai vadhūḥ sthitā sādhvī brāhmaṇapriyakāmyayā,
14.90.68: santānāt tava santānaṁ mama vipra bhaviṣyati,
14.90.69: putreṇa tānavāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati ॥69॥
14.90.70: dharmādyā hi yathā tretā vahnitretā tathaiva ca,
14.90.74: kr̥cchravr̥ttiṁ nirāhārāṁ drakṣyāmi tvāṁ kathaṁ śubhe ॥74॥
14.90.75: bālā kṣudhārtā nārī ca rakṣyā tvaṁ satataṁ mayā,
14.90.77: tava vipra prasādena lokān prāpsyāmahe śubhān ॥77॥
14.90.78: avekṣyā iti kr̥tvāhaṁ dr̥ḍhabhakteti vā dvija,
14.90.79: anena nityaṁ sādhvī tvaṁ śīlavr̥ttena śobhase,
14.90.80: tasmāt saktūn grahīṣyāmi vadhu nārhasi vañcanām,
gaṇayitvā mahābhāge tvāṁ hi dharmabhr̥tāṁ vare ॥80॥
14.90.82: prītātmā sa tu taṁ vākyamidamāha dvijarṣabham,
14.90.83: aho dānaṁ ghuṣyate te svarge svarganivāsibhiḥ ॥83॥
14.90.84: gaganāt puṣpavarṣaṁ ca paśyedaṁ patitaṁ bhuvi,
14.90.86: kāṅkṣante darśanaṁ tubhyaṁ divaṁ vraja dvijarṣabha,
14.90.88: asaṅkareṇa dharmeṇa tasmād gaccha divaṁ dvija,
14.90.89: sarvametaddhi yasmāt te dattaṁ śuddhena cetasā ॥89॥
14.90.90: kr̥cchrakāle tataḥ svargo vijitaḥ karmaṇā tvayā,
14.90.91: bubhukṣāṁ jayate yastu sa svargaṁ jayate dhruvam ॥91॥
14.90.92: yadā dānaruciḥ syād vai tadā dharmo na sīdati,
14.90.93: dharmameva guruṁ jñātvā tr̥ṣṇā na gaṇitā tvayā,
dravyāgamo nr̥ṇāṁ sūkṣmaḥ pātre dānaṁ tataḥ param ॥93॥
14.90.94: kālaḥ parataro dānācchraddhā caiva tataḥ parā,
14.90.95: taṁ tu paśyanti puruṣā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ ॥95॥
14.90.97: dadyādapaśca yaḥ śaktyā sarve tulyaphalāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
14.90.98: śuddhena manasā vipra nākapr̥ṣṭhaṁ tato gataḥ,
14.90.100: ekāṁ dattvā sa pārakyāṁ narakaṁ samapadyata,
14.90.101: vibhavo na nr̥ṇāṁ puṇyaṁ svaśaktyā svarjitaṁ satām ॥101॥
14.90.102: krodhād dānaphalaṁ hanti lobhāt svargaṁ na gacchati ॥102॥
14.90.106: ārohata yathākāmaṁ dharmo’smi dvija paśya mām,
tārito hi tvayā deho loke kīrtiḥ sthirā ca te ॥106॥
14.90.107: ityuktavākye dharme tu yānamāruhya sa dvijaḥ ॥107॥
14.90.108: tasmin vipre gate svargaṁ sasute sasnuṣe tadā ॥108॥
14.90.110: viprasya tapasā tasya śiro me kāñcanīkr̥tam ॥110॥
14.90.111: śarīrārdhaṁ ca me viprāḥ śātakumbhamayaṁ kr̥tam ॥111॥
14.90.114: āśayā parayā prāpto na cāhaṁ kāñcanīkr̥taḥ,
tato mayoktaṁ tad vākyaṁ prahasya brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ ॥114॥
14.90.119: na vismayaste nr̥pate yajñe kāryaḥ kathañcana,
14.90.120: tapo damaśca satyaṁ ca pradānaṁ ceti sammitam ॥120॥
14.90.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi nakulākhyāne navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥90॥
14.91.1: śāntivyavasthitā viprāḥ śame dama iti prabho ॥1॥
14.91.3: iha kīrtiṁ parāṁ prāpya pretya svargamavāpnuyuḥ ॥3॥
14.91.6: atha kasmāt sa nakulo garhayāmāsa taṁ kratum,
14.91.7: yajñasya vidhimagryaṁ vai phalaṁ cāpi narādhipa,
gadataḥ śr̥ṇu me rājan yathāvadiha bhārata ॥7॥
14.91.12: tato dīnān paśūn dr̥ṣṭvā r̥ṣayaste tapodhanāḥ,
ūcuḥ śakraṁḥ samāgamya nāyaṁ yajñavidhiḥ śubhaḥ ॥12॥
14.91.13: na hi yajñe paśugaṇā vidhidr̥ṣṭāḥ purandara ॥13॥
14.91.14: nāyaṁ dharmakr̥to yajño na hiṁsā dharma ucyate ॥14॥
14.91.15: āgamenaiva te yajñaṁ kurvantu yadi cecchasi ॥15॥
14.91.26: dānena kīrtirbhavati na pretyeha ca durmateḥ ॥26॥
14.91.27: dharmābhiśaṅkī yajate na sa dharmaphalaṁ labhet ॥27॥
14.91.29: pāpena karmaṇā vipro dhanaṁ prāpya niraṅkuśaḥ,
14.91.31: evaṁ labdhvā dhanaṁ mohād yo hi dadyād yajeta vā,
na tasya sa phalaṁ pretya bhuṅkte pāpadhanāgamāt ॥31॥
14.91.32: dānaṁ vibhavato dattvā narāḥ svaryānti dhārmikāḥ ॥32॥
14.91.33: eṣa dharmo mahāyogo dānaṁ bhūtadayā tathā,
14.91.34: śrūyante hi purā vr̥ttā viśvāmitrādayo nr̥pāḥ ॥34॥
14.91.36: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ siddhiṁ paramikāṁ gatāḥ,
14.91.37: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā ye cāśritāstapaḥ,
14.92.10: tasmin satre tu yad vr̥ttaṁ yad yogyaṁ ca tadābhavat ॥10॥
14.92.13: na ca varṣati parjanyaḥ kathamannaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥13॥
14.92.17: provāca vākyaṁ sa tadā prasādya śirasā munīn,
14.92.21: bījairhi taṁ kariṣyāmi nātra vighno bhaviṣyati,
nedaṁ śakyaṁ vr̥thā kartuṁ mama satraṁ kathañcana ॥21॥
14.92.22: varṣiṣyatīha vā devo na vā varṣaṁ bhaviṣyati,
14.92.24: viśeṣaṁ caiva kartāsmi punaḥ punaratīva hi,
14.92.26: viśvāvasuśca ye cānye te’pyupāsantu me makham,
uttarebhyaḥ kurubhyaśca yat kiñcid vasu vidyate ॥26॥
14.92.30: prītāḥ sma tava vākyena na tvicchāmastapovyayam,
14.92.39: prāha mānuṣavad vācametat pr̥ṣṭo vadasva me ॥39॥
14.92.40: etat pūrvaṁ na pr̥ṣṭo’haṁ na cāsmābhiḥ prabhāṣitam,
śrūyatāṁ nakulo yo’sau yathā vāk tasya mānuṣī ॥40॥
14.92.42: tat payaḥ sthāpayāmāsa nave bhāṇḍe dr̥ḍhe śucau,
14.92.43: iti sañcintya dharmaḥ sa dharṣayāmāsa tat payaḥ ॥43॥
14.92.44: tamājñāya muniḥ krodhaṁ naivāsya sa cukopa ha,
sa tu krodhastato rājan brāhmaṇīṁ mūrtimāsthitaḥ,
14.92.46: bibhemi tapasaḥ sādho prasādaṁ kuru me prabho ॥46॥
14.92.47: sākṣād dr̥ṣṭo’si me krodha gaccha tvaṁ vigatajvaraḥ,
na tvayāpakr̥taṁ me’dya na ca me manyurasti vai ॥47॥
14.92.48: yān samuddiśya saṅkalpaḥ payaso’sya kr̥to mayā,
14.92.51: taiścokto yajñiyān deśān dharmāraṇyaṁ tathaiva ca,
jugupsamāno dhāvan sa taṁ yajñaṁ samupāsadat ॥51॥
14.92.52: muktaḥ śāpāt tataḥ krodho dharmo hyāsīd yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥52॥
14.92.53: evametat tadā vr̥tte yajñe tasya mahātmanaḥ,
14.92.53d4: yadi jānāsi māṁ bhaktaṁ snigdhaṁ vā bhaktavatsala.
14.92.53d6: śrutā me mānavā dharmā vāśiṣṭhāḥ kāśyapāstathā,
14.92.53d8: brahmaṇā kathitā ye ca kaumārāśca śrutā mayā,
14.92.53d12: bālakhilyakr̥tā ye ca ye ca saptarṣibhistathā,
14.92.53d14: nāradīyāḥ śrutā dharmāḥ kāpotāśca śrutā mayā,
14.92.53d17: pāvanatvāt pavitratvād viśiṣṭā iti me matiḥ.
14.92.53d18: tasmāddhi tvāṁ prapannasya tvadbhaktasya ca keśava,
yuṣmadīyān varān dharmān puṇyān kathaya me’cyuta.
14.92.53d20: evaṁ te yasya kaunteya yatno dharmeṣu suvrata,
tasya te durlabho loke na kaścidapi vidyate.
14.92.53d21: dharmaḥśruto vā dr̥ṣṭo vā kathito vā kr̥to’pi vā,
14.92.53d22: dharmaḥ pitā ca mātā ca dharmo nāthaḥ suhr̥t tathā,
dharmo bhrātā sakhā caiva dharmaḥ svāmī parantapa.
14.92.53d23: dharmādarthaśca kāmaśca dharmād bhogāḥ sukhāni ca,
14.92.53d24: dharmād dvijatvaṁ devatvaṁ dharmaḥ pāvayate naram.
14.92.53d25: yadā ca kṣīyate pāpaṁ kālena puruṣasya tu,
14.92.53d26: tad gatvāpīha yo dharmaṁ na karoti svavañcitaḥ.
14.92.53d27: paradveṣyāśca mūrkhāśca na tairdharmaḥ kr̥taḥ purā.
14.92.53d28: ye ca dīrghāyuṣaḥ śūrāḥ paṇḍitā bhoginastathā,
14.92.53d29: evaṁ dharmaḥ kr̥taḥ śuddho nayate gatimuttamām,
14.92.53d30: kathayiṣye paraṁ dharmaṁ tava bhaktasya pāṇḍava.
14.92.53d32: idaṁ me mānuṣaṁ janma kr̥tamātmani māyayā,
14.92.53d34: ye ca māṁ sarvabhūtasthaṁ paśyanti jñānacakṣuṣā,
14.92.53d35: madbhaktānāṁ tu mānuṣye saphalaṁ janma pāṇḍava.
14.92.53d38: yacca rūpaṁ paraṁ guhyaṁ kūṭasthamacalaṁ dhruvam,
14.92.53d39: aparaṁ yacca me rūpaṁ prādurbhāveṣu dr̥śyate,
14.92.53d40: darśayāmīha tad rūpaṁ yacca paśyanti me surāḥ.
14.92.53d44: mūrddhānaṁ me viddhi divaṁ candrādityau ca locane,
gāvo’gnirbrāhmaṇo vaktraṁ mārutaḥ śvasanaṁ ca me.
14.92.53d45: diśo me bāhavaścāṣṭau nakṣatrāṇi ca bhūṣaṇam,
14.92.53d47: triguṇo’gnau sthito’haṁ vai salile ca caturguṇaḥ.
14.92.53d48: śabdādyā ye guṇāḥ pañca mahābhūteṣu pañcasu,
14.92.53d53: sudhā cāhaṁ svadhā cāhaṁ svāhā cāhaṁ narādhipa,
14.92.53d55: saṁhr̥tyāhaṁ jagat sarvaṁ kr̥tvā vai garbhamātmanaḥ,
14.92.53d56: sthitvā sr̥jāmi bhūtāni jaṅgamāni sthirāṇi ca.
14.92.53d57: kalpe kalpe ca bhūtāni saṁharāmi sr̥jāmi ca,
na ca māṁ tāni jānanti māyayā mohitāni me.
14.92.53d59: na tadasti kvacid rājan yatrāhaṁ na pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
na ca tad vidyate bhūtaṁ mayi yanna pratiṣṭhitam.
14.92.53d60: yāvanmātraṁ bhaved bhūtaṁ sthūlaṁ sūkṣmamidaṁ jagat,
14.92.53d61: kiṁ cātra bahunoktena satyametad bravīmi te,
yad bhūtaṁ yad bhaviṣyacca tat sarvamahameva tu.
14.92.53d62: mayā sr̥ṣṭāni bhūtāni manmayāni ca bhārata,
māmeva na vijānanti māyayā mohitāni vai.
14.92.53d68: evaṁ śrutvā vacaḥ puṇyaṁ satyaṁ keśavabhāṣitam,
14.92.53d71: hr̥di kartuṁ ca tadvākyaṁ praṇemuḥ śirasā natāḥ.
14.92.53d73: vaiśyasya kīdr̥śī deva gatiḥ śūdrasya kīdr̥śī.
14.92.53d75: yaiśca pūrṇāhutiḥ prāptā vidhivajjuhvate ca ye.
14.92.53d76: vaiśvadevaṁ ca ye cakruḥ pūjayantyatithīṁśca ye,
14.92.53d81: viprebhyaḥ kāmado nityaṁ bhr̥tyānāṁ bharaṇe rataḥ,
14.92.53d88: tasmād dharmaḥ sadā kāryo mānuṣyaṁ prāpya durlabham,
na hi dharmānuraktānāṁ loke kiñcana durlabham.
14.92.53d89: sa tena kṣapayet pāpaṁ samyagācaritena ca.
14.92.53d90: sahajaṁ yad bhavet karma na tat tyājyaṁ hi kenacit,
sa eva tasya dharmo hi tena siddhiṁ sa gacchati.
14.92.53d92: bhagavan devadeveśa śrotuṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me,
14.92.53d95: yathoṣṇaṁ vā bhavedalpaṁ śītena bahunā vr̥tam,
śītalaṁ ca bhavet sarvamuṣṇatvaṁ ca vinaśyati.
14.92.53d96: evaṁ ca yad bhaved bhūri sukr̥taṁ vāpi duṣkr̥tam,
14.92.53d97: gūhitasya bhaved vr̥ddhiḥ kīrtitasya bhavet kṣayaḥ.
14.92.53d98: tathā kr̥tastu rājendra dharmo naśyati mānada.
14.92.53d99: tāvubhau gūhitau samyag vr̥ddhiṁ yāto na saṁśayaḥ,
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena na pāpaṁ gūhayed budhaḥ.
14.92.53d101: tasmāt saṅkīrtayet pāpaṁ nityaṁ dharmaṁ ca gūhayet.
14.92.53d103: vr̥thā ca kati janmāni vr̥thā dānāni kāni ca,
vr̥thā ca jīvitaṁ keṣāṁ narāṇāṁ puruṣottama.
14.92.53d105: garbhasthaḥ kiṁ samaśnāti kiṁ bālye vāpi keśava,
yauvanasthe’pi kiṁ kr̥ṣṇa vārdhake vāpi kiṁ bhavet.
14.92.53d106: sāttvikaṁ kīdr̥śaṁ dānaṁ rājasaṁ kīdr̥śaṁ bhavet,
tāmasaṁ kīdr̥śaṁ deva tarpayiṣyati kiṁ prabho.
14.92.53d107: uttamaṁ kīdr̥śaṁ dānaṁ teṣāṁ vā kiṁ phalaṁ bhavet,
kiṁ dānaṁ nayati hyūrdhvaṁ kiṁ gatiṁ madhyamāṁ nayet,
gatiṁ jaghanyāmatha vā devadeva vadasva me.
14.92.53d108: etadicchāmi vijñātuṁ paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me,
tvadīyaṁ vacanaṁ satyaṁ puṇyaṁ ca madhusūdana.
14.92.53d110: vr̥thā ca daśa janmāni catvāri ca narādhipa,
14.92.53d111: vr̥thā ca jīvitaṁ yeṣāṁ te ca ṣaṭ parikīrtitāḥ,
14.92.53d112: dharmaghnānāṁ vr̥thā janma lubdhānāṁ pāpināṁ tathā,
vr̥thā pākaṁ ca ye’śnanti paradāraratāśca ye,
pākabhedakarā ye ca ye ca syuḥ satyavarjitāḥ.
14.92.53d113: pitaraṁ mātaraṁ caiva upādhyāyaṁ guruṁ tathā,
mātulaṁ mātulānīṁ ca yo nihanyācchapeta vā.
14.92.53d115: mama vā śaṅkarasyātha brahmaṇo vā yudhiṣṭhira,
athavā brāhmaṇānāṁ tu ye na bhaktā narādhamāḥ,
14.92.53d116: dambhārthamapi yad dattaṁ yat pākhaṇḍihitaṁ nr̥pa.
14.92.53d117: śūdrācārāya yad dattaṁ yad dattvā cānukīrtitam,
roṣayuktaṁ ca yad dattaṁ yad dattamanuśocitam.
14.92.53d118: dambhārjitaṁ ca yad dattaṁ yacca vāpyanr̥tārjitam,
brāhmaṇasvaṁ ca yad dattaṁ cauryeṇāpyarjitaṁ ca yat.
14.92.53d119: abhiśastāhr̥taṁ yattu yad dattaṁ patite dvije,
14.92.53d122: strījitāya ca yad dattaṁ yad dattaṁ rājasevine,
gaṇakāya ca yad dattaṁ yacca kāraṇikāya ca.
14.92.53d123: bhr̥takāya ca yad dattaṁ vyālagrāhihr̥taṁ ca yat.
14.92.53d124: purohitāya yad dattaṁ cikitsakahr̥taṁ ca yat,
14.92.53d126: sevakāya ca yad dattaṁ yad dattaṁ brāhmaṇabruve.
14.92.53d127: addeśine ca yad dattaṁ dattaṁ vārdhuśikāya ca,
14.92.53d128: yanmithyāliṅgine dattaṁ dattaṁ sarvāśine ca yat.
14.92.53d129: nāstikāya ca yad dattaṁ dharmavikrayiṇe ca yat,
varākāya ca yad dattaṁ yad dattaṁ kūṭasākṣiṇe.
14.92.53d130: vr̥thā bhavati tatsarvaṁ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.
14.92.53d133: eteṣu yat phalaṁ kiñcid bhaviṣyati kathañcana,
14.92.53d134: jīvitaṁ tu tathā hyeṣāṁ tacchr̥ṇuṣva yudhiṣṭhira.
14.92.53d135: ye māṁ na pratipadyante śaṅkaraṁ vā narādhamāḥ,
brāhmaṇān vā mahīdevān vr̥thā jīvanti te narāḥ.
14.92.53d136: devān nindantyanācārā vr̥thā jīvanti te narāḥ.
14.92.53d137: viprān nindanti yajñāṁśca vr̥thā jīvanti te narāḥ.
14.92.53d138: ye durgāṁ vā kumāraṁ vā vāyumagniṁ jalaṁ ravim,
mūḍhā nindantyanācārā vr̥thā jīvanti te narāḥ.
14.92.53d139: mr̥ṣṭamaśnāti yaścaiko vr̥thā jīvati so’pi ca,
14.92.53d140: tamoniviṣṭacittena dattaṁ dānaṁ tu yad bhavet,
14.92.53d141: dadāti dānaṁ yo martyo bālabhāve tadaśnute.
14.92.53d142: dadāti dānaṁ yo martyo vr̥ddhabhāve tadaśnute.
14.92.53d143: dadāti dānaṁ yo martyo yauvane sa tadaśnute.
14.92.53d144: svayaṁ nītvā tu yad dānaṁ bhaktyā pātre pradīyate,
14.92.53d145: rājasaṁ sāttvikaṁ cāpi tāmasaṁ ca yudhiṣṭhira,
dānaṁ dānaphalaṁ caiva gatiṁ ca trividhāṁ śr̥ṇu.
14.92.53d146: dānaṁ dātavyamityeva matiṁ kr̥tvā dvijāya vai,
14.92.53d148: samr̥ddhāya ca yad dattaṁ tad dānaṁ rājasaṁ smr̥tam.
14.92.53d149: sambandhine ca yad dattaṁ pramattāya ca pāṇḍava,
14.92.53d150: dīyate taskarāyāpi tad dānaṁ tāmasaṁ smr̥tam.
14.92.53d151: sevakāya ca yad dattaṁ tat tāmasamudāhr̥tam.
14.92.53d154: tāmasaṁ dānamaśnanti gatiṁ ca trividhāṁ śr̥ṇu.
14.92.53d155: madhyamaṁ rājasānāṁ tu tāmasānāṁ tu paścimam.
14.92.53d156: madhyamaṁ tu samāhūya jaghanyaṁ yācate phalam.
14.92.53d157: samāhūya tu yo dadyānmadhyamāṁ sa gatiṁ vrajet,
yācito yaśca vai dadyājjaghanyāṁ sa gatiṁ vrajet.
14.92.53d158: uttamā daivikī jñeyā madhyamā mānuṣī gatiḥ,
14.92.53d162: tasmād dānaṁ sadā kāryaṁ paratra hitamicchatā.
14.92.53d165: āmantrya tu nirāśāni na kartavyāni bhārata,
14.92.53d167: ubhe sandhye’dhitiṣṭhāmi hyaskannaṁ tad vrataṁ mama.
14.92.53d172: na brāhmaṇān parīkṣeta daive karmaṇi dharmavit,
14.92.53d173: śvatvaṁ prāpnoti ninditvā parīvādāt kharo bhavet,
14.92.53d174: durvr̥ttā vā suvr̥ttā vā prākr̥tā vā susaṁskr̥tāḥ,
14.92.53d175: kṣatriyaṁ caiva sarpaṁ ca brāhmaṇaṁ ca bahuśrutam,
14.92.53d179: manyuṁ notpādayet teṣāṁ na cāriṣṭaṁ samācaret,
14.92.53d180: manyunā ghnanti te śatrūn vajreṇendra ivāsurān,
brāhmaṇo hi mahad daivaṁ jātimātreṇa jāyate.
14.92.53d181: kiṁ punarye ca kaunteya sandhyāṁ nityamupāsate.
14.92.53d182: kavyāni caiva pitaraḥ kiṁ bhūtamadhikaṁ tataḥ.
14.92.53d184: svameva brāhmaṇo bhuṅkte svayaṁ vaste dadāti ca,
tasmāt te nāvamantavyā madbhaktā hi dvijāḥ sadā.
14.92.53d185: āraṇyakopaniṣadi ye tu paśyanti māṁ dvijāḥ,
14.92.53d186: svagr̥he vā pravāse vā divārātramathāpi vā,
śraddhayā brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyā madbhaktā ye ca pāṇḍava.
14.92.53d187: nāsti viprasamaṁ daivaṁ nāsti viprasamo guruḥ,
nāsti viprāt paro bandhurnāsti viprāt paro nidhiḥ.
14.92.53d188: nāsti viprāt paraṁ tīrthaṁ na puṇyaṁ brāhmaṇāt param,
na pavitraṁ paraṁ viprānna dvijāt pāvanaṁ param,
nāsti viprāt paro dharmo nāsti viprāt parā gatiḥ.
14.92.53d189: trāyate pātramapyekaṁ pātrabhūte tu tad dvije.
14.92.53d191: pradānaiḥ pūjito vipro vandito vāpi saṁskr̥taḥ,
sambhāvito vā dr̥ṣṭo vā madbhakto divamunnayet.
14.92.53d192: ye paṭhanti namasyanti dhyāyanti puruṣāstu mām,
sa tān dr̥ṣṭvā ca spr̥ṣṭvā ca naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate.
