14.92.53d194: svayaṁ nītvā viśeṣeṇa dānaṁ teṣāṁ gr̥heṣvatha,
14.92.53d195: hr̥daye na praṇaśyāmi yasya viprasya bhāvataḥ.
14.92.53d196: sa pūjito vā dr̥ṣṭo vā spr̥ṣṭo vāpi dvijottamaḥ,
sambhāṣito vā rājendra punātyevaṁ naraṁ sadā.
14.92.53d198: śrutvaivaṁ sāttvikaṁ dānaṁ rājasaṁ tāmasaṁ tathā,
pr̥thakpr̥thaktvena gatiṁ phalaṁ cāpi pr̥thak pr̥thak.
14.92.53d200: bījadoṣeṇa lokeśa jāyante ca kathaṁ narāḥ.
14.92.53d201: brāhmaṇānāṁ viśeṣaṁ ca guṇadoṣau ca keśava.
14.92.53d202: yena tiṣṭhati loko’yaṁ vinaśyati ca pāṇḍava.
14.92.53d203: sa bījaṁ nāma vijñeyaṁ tasya bījaṁ śubhaṁ bhavet.
14.92.53d205: sā praśastā varārohā tasyāḥ yoniḥ praśasyate,
manasā karmaṇā vācā yā gacchet parapūruṣam,
14.92.53d206: daive pitrye tathā dāne bhojane sahabhāṣaṇe,
śayane saha sambandhe na yogyā duṣṭayonijāḥ.
14.92.53d208: yo yatra tatra vā retaḥ siktvā śūdrāsu vā caret,
kāmacārī sa pāpātmā bījaṁ tasyāśubhaṁ bhavet.
14.92.53d209: aśuddhaṁ tad bhaved bījaṁ śuddhāṁ yoniṁ na cārhati,
dūṣayatyapi tāṁ yoniṁ śunā līḍhaṁ haviryathā.
14.92.53d210: ātmā hi śukramuddiṣṭaṁ daivataṁ paramaṁ mahat,
14.92.53d211: āyustejo balaṁ vīryaṁ prajñā śrīśca mahad yaśaḥ,
puṇyaṁ ca matpriyatvaṁ ca labhate brahmacaryayā.
14.92.53d213: nāvaṁ vedamayīṁ kr̥tvā tarante tārayanti ca.
14.92.53d214: yo japet pāvanīṁ devīṁ gāyatrīṁ vedamātaram,
na sīdet pratigr̥hṇānaḥ pr̥thivīṁ ca sasāgarām.
14.92.53d215: ye cāsya duḥsthitāḥ kecid grahāḥ sūryādayo divi,
te cāsya saumyā jāyante śivāḥ śubhakarāstathā.
14.92.53d216: ghorarūpā mahākāyā dharṣayanti na taṁ dvijam.
14.92.53d217: caturṇāmapi vedānāṁ sā hi rājan garīyasī.
14.92.53d220: bhūrbhuvaḥ svariti brahma yo vedanirato dvijaḥ,
svadāranirato dāntaḥ sa vidvān sa ca bhūsuraḥ.
14.92.53d221: te yānti naraśārdūla brahmalokaṁ na saṁśayaḥ.
14.92.53d223: caturṇāmapi vedānāṁ sā hi rājan garīyasī.
14.92.53d224: yathā vikasite puṣpe madhu gr̥hṇanti ṣaṭpadāḥ,
evaṁ gr̥hītā sāvitrī sarvavede ca pāṇḍava.
14.92.53d225: tasmāt tu sarvavedānāṁ sāvitrī prāṇa ucyate,
nirjīvā hītare vedā vinā sāvitriyā nr̥pa.
14.92.53d230: stauti yaḥ stutibhirmāṁ ca r̥gyajuḥsāmabhiḥ sadā,
na toṣayati ced viprān nāhaṁ tuṣyāmi bhārata.
14.92.53d231: brāhmaṇe pūjite nityaṁ pūjito’smi na saṁśayaḥ,
14.92.53d232: parā mayi gatisteṣāṁ pūjayanti dvijaṁ hi ye,
14.92.53d234: nāvamānyā dvijāḥ prājñairmama rūpā hi te dvijāḥ.
14.92.53d239: ye ca viprān nirīkṣante pāpāḥ pāpena cakṣuṣā,
14.92.53d241: yaḥ prahāraṁ dvijendrāya dadyāt kuryācca śoṇitam,
asthibhaṅgaṁ ca yaḥ kuryāt prāṇairvā viprayojayet,
14.92.53d242: nāvamucyeta durmedhā na tasya kṣīyate gatiḥ.
14.92.53d243: brāhmaṇān vā vicāryaiva vrajan vai vadhakāṅkṣayā,
14.92.53d244: na brūyāt paruṣāṁ vāṇīṁ na caivainānatikramet.
14.92.53d245: ye viprān ślakṣṇayā vācā pūjayanti narottamāḥ,
14.92.53d246: tarjayanti ca ye viprān kośayanti ca bhārata,
14.92.53d247: devadeveśa daityaghna paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me,
etat kathaya sarvajña tvadbhaktasya ca keśava,
14.92.53d252: kiṁ rūpaṁ kiṁ pramāṇaṁ vā varṇaḥ ko vāsya keśava,
jīvasya gacchato nityaṁ yamalokaṁ vadasva me.
14.92.53d253: śr̥ṇu rājan yathāvr̥ttaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi,
14.92.53d255: na tatra vr̥kṣacchāyā vā na taṭākaṁ saro’pi vā,
na vāpyo dīrghikā vāpi na kūpo vā yudhiṣṭhira.
14.92.53d256: na maṇḍapaṁ sabhā vāpi na prapā na niketanam,
na parvato nadī vāpi na bhūmervivaraṁ kvacit.
14.92.53d257: na grāmo nāśramo vāpi nodyānaṁ vā vanāni ca,
14.92.53d261: chedanād bhedanād dāhāt tāḍanād vā na naśyati.
14.92.53d270: pūrvāhṇe vā parāhṇe vā sandhyākāle’thavā punaḥ,
14.92.53d272: kvacid bhītaiḥ kvacinmattaiḥ praskhaladbhiḥ kvacit kvacit,
14.92.53d280: visrabdhaṁ svāminaṁ mitraṁ striyaṁ vā ghnanti ye narāḥ,
14.92.53d281: khādayanti ca ye jīvān duḥkhamāpādayanti te,
14.92.53d282: ye haranti ca vastrāṇi śayyāḥ prāvaraṇāni ca,
te yānti vidrutā nagnāḥ piśācā iva tatpatham.
14.92.53d283: gāśca dhānyaṁ hiraṇyaṁ vā balāt kṣetraṁ gr̥haṁ tathā,
14.92.53d286: ākrośantīha ye nityaṁ praharanti ca ye dvijān.
14.92.53d290: tataśca muktāḥ kālena loke cāsmin narādhamāḥ,
14.92.53d292: mamānnaṁ dīyatāṁ svāmin pānīyaṁ dīyatāṁ mama,
14.92.53d293: ye prayacchanti viprebhyaste sukhaṁ yānti tatphalam.
14.92.53d294: annaṁ ye ca prayacchanti brāhmaṇebhyaḥ susaṁskr̥tam,
14.92.53d296: ye ca nityaṁ prabhāṣante satyaṁ niṣkalmaṣaṁ vacaḥ,
14.92.53d299: upānahau ca chatraṁ ca śayanānyāsanāni ca,
14.92.53d301: ye phalāni prayacchanti puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca,
14.92.53d304: ye tilaṁ tiladhenuṁ vā ghr̥tadhenumathāpi vā,
14.92.53d306: teṣāṁ vāpyaśca kūpāśca taṭākāni sarāṁsi ca,
14.92.53d312: ārāmān vr̥kṣaṣaṇḍāṁśca ropayanti ca ye narāḥ,
14.92.53d315: bhūmidā yānti taṁ lokaṁ sarvakāmaiḥ sutarpitāḥ,
14.92.53d318: dīpadā yānti yānaiśca dyotayanto diśo daśa,
14.92.53d322: svāgatena ca yo viprān pūjayedāsanena ca,
14.92.53d323: namaskaroti nityaṁ gāṁ sa sukhaṁ yāti tatpatham.
14.92.53d326: te’pi sārasayuktena yānti yānena vai sukham.
14.92.53d328: caturthena ca bhuktena vartante ye jitendriyāḥ,
14.92.53d332: ye ca māsopavāsaṁ vai kurvate saṁyatendriyāḥ,
14.92.53d333: gokr̥te strīkr̥te caiva hatvā viprakr̥te’pi ca,
14.92.53d340: pānīyaṁ paramaṁ loke jīvānāṁ jīvanaṁ smr̥tam,
14.92.53d343: tasmāt toyaṁ sadā deyaṁ tr̥ṣitebhyo vijānatā.
14.92.53d345: adbhiḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni jīvanti prabhavanti ca,
14.92.53d346: taistu dattāḥ svayaṁ prāṇā bhavanti bharatarṣabha.
14.92.53d347: annād raktaṁ ca śukraṁ ca anne jīvaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
14.92.53d348: tejo balaṁ ca rūpaṁ ca sattvaṁ vīryaṁ dhr̥tirdyutiḥ,
14.92.53d349: sarvakālaṁ hi sarveṣām anne prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ.
14.92.53d351: annenādhiṣṭhitaḥ prāṇa apāno vyāna eva ca,
14.92.53d354: annāda yasmāt pravartante tasmādannaṁ paraṁ smr̥tam.
14.92.53d356: yasmādannāt prajāḥ sarvāḥ kalpe kalpe’sr̥jat prabhuḥ,
tasmādannāt paraṁ dānaṁ na bhūtaṁ na bhaviṣyati.
14.92.53d357: yasmādannāt pravartante dharmārthau kāma eva ca,
tasmādannāt paraṁ dānaṁ nāmutreha ca pāṇḍava.
14.92.53d358: tuṣyantyannena yasmāt tu tasmādannaṁ paraṁ bhavet.
14.92.53d363: agrabhikṣāṁ ca yo dadyād daridrāya dvijātaye,
ṣaṇmāsān vārṣikaṁ śrāddhaṁ tasya puṇyaphalaṁ śr̥ṇu.
14.92.53d364: tat puṇyaphalamāpnoti naro vai nātra saṁśayaḥ.
14.92.53d367: taṁ pūjayet tu yatnena so’tithiḥ svargasaṅkramaḥ.
14.92.53d372: ye prayacchanti viprebhyo nopasarpanti te yamam.
14.92.53d373: viprātithye kr̥te rājan bhaktyā śuśrūṣite’pi ca,
14.92.53d374: tayoḥ pūjāṁ dvijaḥ kuryāditi paurāṇikī śrutiḥ.
14.92.53d381: moghaṁ dhruvaṁ prorṇayati moghamasya tu pacyate,
moghamannaṁ sadāśnāti yo’tithiṁ na ca pūjayet.
14.92.53d382: sāṅgopāṅgāṁstu yo vedān paṭhatīha dine dine,
na cātithiṁ pūjayati vr̥thā bhavati sa dvijaḥ.
14.92.53d384: teṣāṁ yaśo’bhikāmānāṁ dattamiṣṭaṁ ca yad bhavet,
vr̥thā bhavati tat sarvamāśayā hi tayā hatam.
14.92.53d385: deśaṁ kālaṁ ca pātraṁ ca svaśaktiṁ ca nirīkṣya ca,
14.92.53d387: hitaḥ priyo vā dveṣyo vā mūrkhaḥ paṇḍita eva vā,
14.92.53d396: sarvātithyaṁ tu yaḥ kuryād yathāśraddhaṁ nareśvara,
14.92.53d401: yaḥ prayacchati viprāya bhūmiṁ ramyāṁ sadakṣiṇām,
14.92.53d403: yāti yānena divyena mama lokaṁ mahāyaśāḥ.
14.92.53d404: na hi bhūmipradānād vai dānamanyad viśiṣyate,
14.92.53d406: sarvadānāni vai rājan dadāti vasudhāṁ dadat.
14.92.53d407: sāgarān saritaḥ śailān samāni viṣamāṇi ca,
14.92.53d409: na tat phalaṁ labhante te bhūmidānasya yat phalam.
14.92.53d411: prītaye viddhi rājendra bhūmirdattā dvijāya vai.
14.92.53d414: māsopavāse yat puṇyaṁ kr̥cchre cāndrāyaṇe’pi ca,
14.92.53d418: pratyak prāgapi rājendra tat tathā dakṣiṇottaram,
14.92.53d422: citraguptaḥ kaliḥ kālaḥ kr̥tānto mr̥tyureva ca,
14.92.53d423: ahaṁ ca prītimān rājan pūjayāmo mahīpradam.
14.92.53d426: yathā hi dhātrī kṣīreṇa putraṁ vardhayati svayam,
14.92.53d428: tathā kāmāḥ prarohanti bhūmidasya dine dine.
14.92.53d429: yathā tejastu sūryasya tamaḥ sarvaṁ vyapohati,
14.92.53d430: āśrutya bhūmidānaṁ tu dattvā yo vā haret punaḥ,
sa baddho vāruṇaiḥ pāśaiḥ kṣipyate pūyaśoṇite.
14.92.53d431: svadattāṁ paradattāṁ vā yo hareta vasundharām,
na tasya narakād ghorād vidyate niṣkr̥tiḥ kvacit.
14.92.53d432: narakebhyo vinirmuktaḥ śunāṁ yoniṁ sa gacchati.
14.92.53d435: yasya yasya yadā bhūmistasya tasya tadā phalam.
14.92.53d436: yaśca rūpyaṁ prayacched vai daridrāya dvijātaye,
14.92.53d439: viśeṣeṇa daridrāya tasyāpi śr̥ṇu yat phalam.
14.92.53d440: tat puṇyaṁ samanuprāpya tatkṣaṇād virajā bhavet.
14.92.53d441: yathā tvacaṁ bhujaṅgo vai tyaktvā śuddhatanurbhavet,
tathā tilapradānād vai pāpaṁ tyaktvā viśuddhyati.
14.92.53d444: tilaṁ gāvaḥ suvarṇaṁ cāpyannaṁ kanyā vasundharā,
14.92.53d445: tarpayed vidhivad rājan sa nidhiḥ pāralaukikaḥ.
14.92.53d446: āhitāgniṁ daridraṁ ca śrotriyaṁ ca jitendriyam,
14.92.53d448: yacca vedamayaṁ pātraṁ yacca pātraṁ tapomayam,
asaṅkīrṇaṁ ca yat pātraṁ tat pātraṁ tārayiṣyati.
14.92.53d452: mayi saṁnyastakarmā ca sa viprastārayed dhruvam.
14.92.53d455: na vidyate suraśreṣṭha mama tr̥ptirhi mādhava.
14.92.53d456: yāni cānyāni dānāni tvayā noktāni kānicit,
14.92.53d460: yaḥ prayacchati viprāya tasya puṇyaphalaṁ śr̥ṇu.
14.92.53d462: caturyugāni vai triṁśat krīḍitvā tatra devavat,
iha mānuṣyake loke vipro bhavati vedavit.
14.92.53d463: vinaśyati tadā pāpaṁ tasya varṣakr̥taṁ nr̥pa.
14.92.53d464: atha prakṣālayet pādau tasya toyena bhaktimān,
14.92.53d465: ghr̥tena vātha tailena pādau tasya tu pūjayet,
14.92.53d466: svāgatena tu yo vipraṁ pūjayedāsanena ca,
pratyutthānena vā rājan sa devānāṁ priyo bhavet.
14.92.53d472: iha rājā bhaved rājan nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.
14.92.53d475: dadāti cepsitaṁ sarvaṁ manasā yad yadicchati.
14.92.53d476: yāvanti tasya patrāṇi puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca,
14.92.53d478: sthāpayitvā tu madbhaktyā yo matpratikr̥tiṁ naraḥ,
ālayaṁ vidhivat kr̥tvā pūjākarma ca kārayet,
svayaṁ vā pūjayed bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṁ śr̥ṇu.
14.92.53d479: na jāne nirgaṁma tasya mama lokād yudhiṣṭhira.
14.92.53d480: prajvālayati yo dīpaṁ tasya puṇyaphalaṁ śr̥ṇu.
14.92.53d481: āruhya kāñcanaṁ yānaṁ dyotayan sarvato diśam,
14.92.53d483: karakāṁ karṇikāṁ vāpi mahad vā jalabhājanam,
yaḥ prayacchati viprāya tasya puṇyaphalaṁ śr̥ṇu.
14.92.53d484: brahmakūrce tu yat pīte phalaṁ proktaṁ narādhipa,
14.92.53d487: pānīyaṁ yaḥ prayacched vai jīvānāṁ jīvanaṁ param,
grīṣme ca triṣu māseṣu tasya puṇyaphalaṁ śr̥ṇu.
14.92.53d489: subhago rūpavān śūraḥ paṇḍitaśca bhaved dvijaḥ.
14.92.53d490: subhago bhavati śrīmān strīṇāṁ nityaṁ manoramaḥ.
14.92.53d491: upānahau ca chatraṁ ca yo dadāti narottamaḥ,
14.92.53d494: sa vimānena divyena yāti śakrapuraṁ naraḥ.
14.92.53d495: sa vimānena divyena yāti śakrapuraṁ naraḥ.
14.92.53d496: vartate caikavarṣaṁ tu tasya puṇyaphalaṁ śr̥ṇu.
14.92.53d497: yāti yānena divyena sa mahendrapuraṁ naraḥ.
14.92.53d500: praviśet sa mahātejā māṁ vā śaṅkarameva vā,
na syāt punarbhavo rājan nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.
14.92.53d501: hanyante ye tu rājendra śakralokaṁ vrajanti te.
14.92.53d503: janmaprabhr̥ti yada dattaṁ tat sarvaṁ tu vinaśyati.
14.92.53d504: yad yadiṣṭatamaṁ dravyaṁ nyāyenopārjitaṁ ca yat,
14.92.53d505: pañca yajñāḥ kathaṁ deva kriyante’tra dvijātibhiḥ,
14.92.53d507: nr̥yajñaṁ pitr̥yajñaṁ ca pañca yajñān pracakṣate.
14.92.53d509: hutaṁ cāpyahutaṁ caiva tathā prahutameva ca,
14.92.53d510: ahutaṁ ca bhaved dattaṁ prahutaṁ brāhmaṇāśitam.
14.92.53d514: tasmāt snātvā dvijo vidvān kuryādetān dine dine,
ato’nyathā tu bhuñjan vai prāyaścittī bhaved dvijaḥ.
14.92.53d515: vaktumarhasi deveśa snānasya ca vidhiṁ mama.
14.92.53d516: śr̥ṇu pāṇḍava tat sarvaṁ pavitraṁ pāpanāśanam,
snātvā yena vidhānena mucyante kilbiṣād dvijāḥ.
14.92.53d517: mr̥daṁ ca gomayaṁ caiva tilaṁ darbhāṁstathaiva ca,
14.92.53d518: nadyāṁ snātvā na ca snāyādanyatra dvijasattamaḥ,
sati prabhūte payasi nālpe snāyāt kadācana.
14.92.53d520: bahiḥ prakṣālya pādau ca dvirācamya prayatnataḥ,
14.92.53d522: tat tu tīrthaṁ samāsādya kuryādācamanaṁ punaḥ.
14.92.53d523: śīrṣaṇyaṁ tu tataḥ prāṇān sakr̥deva tu saṁspr̥śet.
14.92.53d524: bāhū dvau ca tataḥ spr̥ṣṭvā hr̥dayaṁ nābhimeva ca,
pratyaṅgamudakaṁ spr̥ṣṭvā mūrdhānaṁ tu punaḥ spr̥śet.
14.92.53d526: ācamya mr̥ttikāḥ paścāt tridhā kr̥tvā samālabhet,
14.92.53d528: gomayaṁ ca tridhā kr̥tvā jale pūrvaṁ samālabhet,
savyāhr̥tīkāṁ sapraṇavāṁ gāyatrīṁ ca japet punaḥ.
14.92.53d531: sthitvāntaḥ salile sūktaṁ japed vā cāghamarṣaṇam.
14.92.53d532: savyāhr̥tīkāṁ sapraṇavāṁ gāyatrīṁ vā tato japet,
14.92.53d533: utplutya tīrthamāsādya dhaute śukte ca vāsasī,
śuddhe cācchādayet kakṣe na kuryāt paripāśake.
14.92.53d534: pāśena baddhvā kakṣe yat kurute karma vaidikam,
14.92.53d535: tataḥ prakṣālya pādau ca hastau caiva mr̥dā śanaiḥ,
14.92.53d536: jale jalagataḥ śuddhaḥ sthala eva sthalasthitaḥ,
14.92.53d538: samāhito japet tasmāt sāvitryā cābhimantrya ca,
14.92.53d544: sāvitrīṁ ca yathāśakti japtvā sūktaṁ ca māmakam,
14.92.53d549: anvārabhya ca savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu.
14.92.53d552: tr̥pyatāmiti paścāt tu sa pitr̥̄ṁstarpayet tataḥ.
14.92.53d556: vr̥ttiṁ bhr̥tyajanasyāhuḥ snānaṁ pānaṁ ca tadvidaḥ,
atarpayitvā tān pūrvaṁ snānavastraṁ na pīḍayet,
14.92.53d558: prakṣālya tu mr̥dā pādāvācamya prayataḥ punaḥ,
darbheṣu darbhapāṇiḥ san svādhyāyaṁ tu samārabhet.
14.92.53d561: utthāya tu namaskr̥tya diśo digdevatā api,
14.92.53d562: vācaṁ vācaspatiṁ caiva māṁ caiva saritastathā,
14.92.53d563: tato namo’dbhya ityuktvā namaskuryāt tu tajjalam,
14.92.53d566: kumudaṁ karavīraṁ ca caṇakaṁ campakaṁ tathā.
14.92.53d569: tasmāt padmaṁ tathā rājan padmāt tu śatapatrakam,
tasmāt sahasrapatraṁ tu puṇḍarīkaṁ tataḥ param.
14.92.53d570: sauvarṇāt tu prasūnācca matpriyaṁ nāsti pāṇḍava.
14.92.53d573: kiṅkiṇīṁ munipuṣpaṁ ca dhurdhūraṁ pāṭalaṁ tathā.
14.92.53d576: aṅkolaṁ girikarṇī ca nīlānyeva ca sarvaśaḥ,
14.92.53d579: vaikhānasāḥ kathaṁ brūyuḥ kathaṁ vā pāñcarātrikāḥ.
14.92.53d581: vaidikairatha mantraiśca mama sūktena vā punaḥ.
14.92.53d582: puruṣaṁ ca tataḥ satyamacyutaṁ ca yudhiṣṭhira.
14.92.53d583: anye tvevaṁ vijānanti māṁ rājan pāñcarātrikāḥ.
14.92.53d586: tvadbhaktāḥ kīdr̥śā deva kāni teṣāṁ vratāni ca,
14.92.53d590: na dhāvet patite varṣe nāgrabhikṣāṁ ca lopayet.
14.92.53d591: grāsamuṣṭiṁ gave dadyād dhānyāmlaṁ caiva varjayet.
14.92.53d592: aniveditaṁ ca yad dravyaṁ tat prayatnena varjayet.
14.92.53d596: kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca mohaśca mada eva ca,
mahāmohaśca ityete dehe ṣaḍ vr̥ṣalāḥ smr̥tāḥ.
14.92.53d597: garvaḥ stambho hyahaṅkāra īrṣyā ca droha eva ca,
pāruṣyaṁ krūratā caiva saptaite kṣatriyāḥ smr̥tāḥ.
14.92.53d599: tr̥ṣṇā bubhukṣā nidrā ca hyālasyaṁ cāghr̥ṇādayaḥ,
14.92.53d600: bhayaṁ viklavatā jāḍyaṁ pāpakaṁ manyureva ca,
14.92.53d601: āśaucaṁ malinatvaṁ ca śūdrā hyete prakīrtitāḥ,
yasminnete na dr̥śyante sa vai brāhmaṇa ucyate.
14.92.53d602: tasmāt tu sāttviko bhūtvā śuciḥ krodhavivarjitaḥ,
14.92.53d604: teṣāṁ śrāddheṣu tr̥pyanti tena tr̥ptāḥ pitāmahāḥ.
14.92.53d605: dharmo jayati nādharmaḥ satyaṁ jayati nānr̥tam,
kṣamā jayati na krodhaḥ kṣamāvān brāhmaṇo bhavet.
14.92.53d607: yā caiṣā kapilā deva pūrvamutpāditā vibho,
14.92.53d608: sā kathaṁ brāhmaṇebhyo hi deyā kasmin dine’pi vā,
14.92.53d609: kati vā kapilā proktā svayameva svayambhuvā,
kairvā deyāśca tā deva śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ.
14.92.53d611: śr̥ṇu pāṇḍava tattvena pavitraṁ pāvanaṁ param,
14.92.53d612: sarvaṁ tejāḥ samuddhr̥tya nirmitā brahmaṇā purā.
14.92.53d613: pavitraṁ ca pavitrāṇāṁ maṅgalānāṁ ca maṅgalam,
14.92.53d615: kṣīreṇa kapilāyāstu dadhnā vā saghr̥tena vā,
kapilāyā ghr̥tenāpi dadhnā kṣīreṇa vā punaḥ,
14.92.53d618: brahmaṇo hi niyogena nivasanti dine dine.
14.92.53d621: snānena tena puṇyena naṣṭapāpaḥ sa mānavaḥ,
14.92.53d622: tasya naśyati tat pāpaṁ triṁśadrātrakr̥taṁ nr̥pa.
14.92.53d624: sa gaṅgādyeṣu tīrtheṣu snāto bhavati pāṇḍava.
14.92.53d625: dr̥ṣṭvā tu kapilāṁ bhaktyā śrutvā huṅkāraniḥsvanam,
14.92.53d626: gosahasraṁ tu yo dadyādekāṁ ca kapilāṁ naraḥ,
samaṁ tasya phalaṁ prāha brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ.
14.92.53d628: daśa vai kapilāḥ proktāḥ svayameva svayambhuvā,
14.92.53d632: brāhmaṇo vāhayet tāṁstu nānyo varṇaḥ kathañcana,
na vāhayecca kapilāṁ kṣetre vādhvani vā dvijaḥ.
14.92.53d633: na daṇḍena na vā yaṣṭyā na pāśena na vā punaḥ.
14.92.53d634: atr̥pteṣu na bhuñjīyāt pibet pīteṣu codakam.
14.92.53d635: ahaṁ pūrvatra bhāge ca dhuryāṇāṁ vāhanaṁ smr̥tam.
14.92.53d636: yatra ca tvarayā kr̥tyaṁ saṁśayo yatra vādhvani,
vāhayet tatra dhuryāṁstu na sa pāpena lipyate.
14.92.53d637: anyathā vāhayan rājan nirayaṁ yāti rauravam.
14.92.53d639: narakeṣu ca sarveṣu samāḥ sthitvā śataṁ śatam,
14.92.53d640: tasmāt tu muktimanvicchan dadyāt tu kapilāṁ naraḥ.
14.92.53d642: tena dānena pūtātmā mama loke mahīyate.
14.92.53d653: yāścaitāḥ kapilāḥ proktā daśa caiva tvayā mama,
14.92.53d655: śr̥ṇu rājan pavitraṁ vai rahasyaṁ dharmamuttamam.
14.92.53d660: ataḥ paraṁ viśeṣaṁ tu kapilānāṁ bravīmi te,
yaścaitāḥ kapilāḥ proktā daśa rājan mayā tava,
14.92.53d661: piṅgalākṣī ca yā gauśca syāt piṅgalapiṅgalā.
14.92.53d662: namaskr̥tā vā dr̥ṣṭā vā ghnanti pāpaṁ narasya tu.
14.92.53d663: tatra śrīrvijayaḥ kīrtiḥ sphītā nityaṁ yudhiṣṭhira.
14.92.53d664: dadhnā ca tridaśāḥ sarve ghr̥tena tu hutāśanaḥ.
14.92.53d665: kapilāyā ghr̥taṁ kṣīraṁ dadhi pāyasameva vā,
śrotriyebhyaḥ sakr̥d dattvā naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate.
14.92.53d667: saumye muhūrte tat prāśya śuddhātmā śuddhamānasaḥ,
14.92.53d670: tasmāt tu kapilā deyā paratra hitamicchatā.
14.92.53d671: yadā ca dīyate rājan kapilā hyagnihotriṇe,
14.92.53d672: danteṣu maruto devā jihvāyāṁ vāk sarasvatī.
14.92.53d674: nāsāpuṭe sthitā gandhāḥ puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca,
adhare vasavaḥ sarve mukhe cāgniḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ.
14.92.53d675: sādhyā devāḥ sthitāḥ kakṣe grīvāyāṁ pārvatī sthitā,
14.92.53d677: nāsikāyāṁ sadā devī jyeṣṭhā vasati bhāminī,
14.92.53d678: tiṣṭhatyurasi tāsāṁ tu prītaḥ śaktidharo guhaḥ.
14.92.53d680: ratirmedhā kṣamā svāhā śraddhā śāntirdhr̥tiḥ smr̥tiḥ,
14.92.53d683: puṣpavr̥ṣṭiṁ ca varṣanti pranr̥tyanti ca harṣitāḥ.
14.92.53d687: ke tatra pūjāmarhanti varjanīyāśca ke dvijāḥ.
14.92.53d688: kālahīnaṁ ca yad dānaṁ tad dānaṁ rājasaṁ viduḥ.
14.92.53d689: avaghuṣṭaṁ ca yad bhuktamanr̥tena ca bhārata,
parāmr̥ṣṭaṁ śunā vāpi tad bhāgaṁ rākṣasaṁ viduḥ.
14.92.53d690: daive ca pitrye te viprā rājan nārhanti satkriyām.
14.92.53d691: klībaḥ plīhī ca kuṣṭhī ca rājayakṣmānvitaśca yaḥ,
apasmārī ca yaścāpi pitrye nārhati satkr̥tim.
14.92.53d696: raṇakartā ca yo vipro yaśca vāṇijyako dvijaḥ,
14.92.53d698: śrāddhasya brāhmaṇaḥ kālaḥ prāptaṁ dadhi ghr̥taṁ tathā,
darbhāḥ sumanasaḥ kṣetraṁ tatkāle śrāddhado bhavet.
14.92.53d700: arthinaḥ kecidicchanti teṣāṁ dattaṁ mahat phalam,
evaṁ dharmabhr̥tāṁ śreṣṭha jñātvā sarvātmanā tadā,
14.92.53d701: dānaṁ yat te priyaṁ kiñcicchrotriyāṇāṁ ca yat priyam,
14.92.53d702: nirayaṁ ye ca gacchanti tacchr̥ṇuṣva yudhiṣṭhira.
14.92.53d704: upāsate ca tāneva te sarve narakālayāḥ.
14.92.53d705: kṣāntān dāntān kr̥śān prājñān dīrghakālaṁ sahoṣitān,
tyajanti kr̥takr̥tyā ye te vai nirayagāminaḥ.
14.92.53d706: bālānāmapi vr̥ddhānāṁ śrāntānāṁ cāpi ye narāḥ,
14.92.53d708: dānena tapasā caiva satyena ca damena ca,
14.92.53d711: mātaraṁ pitaraṁ caiva śuśrūṣanti ca ye narāḥ,
14.92.53d712: dvārarodhaṁ na kurvanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ.
14.92.53d713: vaivāhikaṁ tu kanyānāṁ daridrāṇāṁ ca ye narāḥ,
kārayanti ca kurvanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ.
14.92.53d715: kṣemākṣemaṁ ca mārgeṣu samāni viṣamāṇi ca,
arthināṁ ye ca vakṣyanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ.
14.92.53d717: dharmādharmau ca kathitau kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi.
14.92.53d721: āśrame vā’’laye vāpi grāme vā nagare’pi vā,
14.92.53d723: yaḥ pravr̥ttāṁ śrutiṁ samyak śāstraṁ vā munibhiḥ kr̥tam,
14.92.53d724: cakṣuṣā vāpi hīnasya paṅgorvāpi jaḍasya vā,
14.92.53d725: guruṁ tvaṅkr̥tya huṅkr̥tya atikramya ca śāsanam,
14.92.53d726: tat sarvasvaṁ hared yo vai tamāhurbrahmaghātakam.
14.92.53d727: sarveṣāmapi dānānāṁ yat tu dānaṁ viśiṣyate,
14.92.53d728: annena sadr̥śaṁ dānaṁ na bhūtaṁ na bhaviṣyati.
14.92.53d729: abhojyānnān mayā rājan vakṣyamāṇān nibodha me.
14.92.53d732: dviṣadannaṁ na bhoktavyaṁ patitānnaṁ ca yacchrutam,
14.92.53d734: sūtānāṁ śauṇḍikānāṁ ca vaidyasya rajakasya ca.
14.92.53d738: matyā bhuktvā sakr̥d vāpi prājāpatyaṁ cared dvijaḥ.
14.92.53d739: dānānāṁ ca phalaṁ yad vai śr̥ṇu pāṇḍava tattvataḥ,
14.92.53d744: tāvubhau gacchataḥ svargaṁ narakaṁ ca viparyaye.
14.92.53d745: anr̥taṁ na vaded vidvāṁstapastaptvā na vismayet,
14.92.53d757: patireva guruḥ strīṇāṁ sarveṣāṁ pārthivo guruḥ.
14.92.53d758: ekadaṇḍī tridaṇḍī vā śikhī vā muṇḍito’pi vā,
14.92.53d759: tasmāt tu yatnataḥ pūjyā madbhaktā matparāyaṇāḥ,
14.92.53d760: praharenna dvijān vipro gāṁ na hanyāt kadācana,
14.92.53d761: nādhaḥ kuryāt kadācit tu na pr̥ṣṭhaṁ paritāpayet.
14.92.53d763: yāvat tu dhārayed vegaṁ tāvadaprayato bhavet.
14.92.53d764: kīdr̥śebhyo hi dātavyaṁ tanme brūhi janārdana.
14.92.53d767: svadharmaniratā ye tu tebhyo dattaṁ mahāphalam.
14.92.53d768: sāṅgāṁśca caturo vedān yo’dhīyeta dine dine,
śūdrānnaṁ yasya no dehe tat pātramr̥ṣayo viduḥ.
14.92.53d772: annāt prabhavati prāṇaḥ pratyakṣaṁ nāsti saṁśayaḥ.
14.92.53d773: kalatraṁ pīḍayitvā tu deśo kāle ca śaktitaḥ,
14.92.53d776: na pr̥cched gotracaraṇaṁ nādhītaṁ vā kadācana.
14.92.53d777: caṇḍālo vā śvapāko vā kāle yaḥ kaścidāgataḥ,
14.92.53d778: pidhāya tu gr̥hadvāraṁ bhuṅkte yo’nnaṁ prahr̥ṣṭavān,
14.92.53d780: kr̥tvā tu pāpaṁ bahuśo yo dadyādannamarthine,
14.92.53d781: annadaḥ prāṇado loke prāṇadaḥ sarvado bhavet,
14.92.53d785: tat tu meghagataṁ bhūmau śakro varṣati tādr̥śam,
tena digdhā bhaved devī mahī prītā ca bhārata.
14.92.53d788: snātaḥ śuciḥ śucau deśe nirjane hutapāvakaḥ.
14.92.53d790: pādābhyāṁ dharaṇīṁ spr̥ṣṭvā pādenaikena vā punaḥ.
14.92.53d791: na bhinnapātre bhuñjīta parṇapr̥ṣṭhe tathaiva ca.
14.92.53d793: jugupsitaṁ ca yaccānnaṁ rākṣasā eva bhuñjate,
14.92.53d794: pañca prāṇāhutīḥ kuryāt samantraṁ tu pr̥thak pr̥thak.
14.92.53d795: yathā rasaṁ na jānāti jihvā prāṇāhutau nr̥pa,
14.92.53d796: yaḥ kuryādāhutīḥ pañca teneṣṭāḥ pañca vāyavaḥ.
14.92.53d799: abhojyaṁ tad vijānīyād bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṁ caret,
svamucchiṣṭaṁ tu yo bhuṅkte yo bhuṅkte muktabhojanam.
14.92.53d800: tayā saha ca yo bhuṅkte sa bhuṅkte madyameva hi,
14.92.53d801: abhojyaṁ tad vijānīyād bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṁ caret.
14.92.53d802: pītaśeṣaṁ tu tannāma na peyaṁ pāṇḍunandana,
pibed yadi hi tanmohād dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṁ caret.
14.92.53d803: bhuñjīta vidhivad vipro na cocchiṣṭaṁ pradāpayet.
14.92.53d804: yathānnena vyathā na syāt tathā bhuñjīta nityaśaḥ.
14.92.53d805: abhojyaṁ tad vijānīyād bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṁ caret.
14.92.53d806: utthāya ca punaḥ smr̥ṣṭaṁ pādaspr̥ṣṭaṁ ca laṅghitam,
annaṁ tad rākṣasaṁ vidyāt tasmāt tat parivarjayet.
14.92.53d809: pitaro vr̥ṣabhā jñeyā gāvo lokasya mātaraḥ,
tāsāṁ tu pūjayā rājan pūjitāḥ pitr̥devatāḥ.
14.92.53d810: śuddhyanti śakr̥tā yāsāṁ kiṁ bhūtamadhikaṁ tataḥ.
14.92.53d811: grāsamuṣṭiṁ paragave dadyāt saṁvatsaraṁ tu yaḥ,
14.92.53d812: gāvo me mātaraḥ sarvāḥ pitaraścaiva govr̥ṣāḥ,
14.92.53d814: yat kr̥taṁ duṣkr̥taṁ tena jñānato’jñānato’pi vā,
tasya naśyati tat sarvaṁ duḥsvapnaṁ ca vinaśyati.
14.92.53d816: tilān dadyāt tilān bhakṣyāt tilān prātarupaspr̥śet,
tilaṁ tilamiti brūyāt tilāḥ pāpaharā hi te.
14.92.53d817: tilān na pīḍayed vipro yantracakre svayaṁ nr̥pa,
pīḍayan hi dvijo mohānnarakaṁ yāti rauravam.
14.92.53d819: samuccayaṁ ca dharmāṇāṁ bhojyābhojyaṁ tathaiva ca,
14.92.53d822: āturo duḥkhito vāpi tathārto vā bubhukṣitaḥ,
14.92.53d823: aṣṭau tānyavrataghnāni āpo mūlaṁ ghr̥taṁ payaḥ,
14.92.53d824: aśakto vidhivat kartuṁ prāyaścittāni yo naraḥ,
14.92.53d825: anr̥tāvr̥tukāle vā divā rātrau tathāpi vā,
proṣitastu striyaṁ gacchet prāyaścittīyate na ca.
14.92.53d827: śrīmānr̥juḥ satyavādī pātrāḥ sarva ime dvijāḥ.
14.92.53d828: tasyāṁ paṅktyāṁ tu ye cānye tān punantyeva darśanāt.
14.92.53d830: nindyān śr̥ṇu dvijān rājannapi vā vedapāragān.
14.92.53d832: ahaṁ cāpi na jānāmi gatiṁ tasya narādhipa.
14.92.53d833: japato juhvato vāpi gatirūrdhvaṁ na vidyate.
14.92.53d834: pañca tasya praṇaśyanti ātmā brahma trayo’gnayaḥ.
14.92.53d836: pretabhūtaṁ tu yaḥ śūdraṁ brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ,
14.92.53d837: trirātre tu tataḥ pūrṇe nadīṁ gatvā samudragām,
14.92.53d838: anāthaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ pretaṁ ye vahanti dvijottamāḥ,
pade pade’śvamedhasya phalaṁ te prāpnuvanti hi.
14.92.53d839: na teṣāmaśubhaṁ kiñcit pāpaṁ vā śubhakarmaṇām,
14.92.53d840: śūdraveśmani vipreṇa kṣīraṁ vā yadi vā dadhi,
nivr̥ttena na bhoktavyaṁ viddhi śūdrānnameva tat.
14.92.53d841: yo vighnaṁ kurute martyastato nānyo’sti pāpakr̥t.
14.92.53d842: sāṅkhyaṁ purāṇaṁ ca kule ca janma,
14.92.53d849: ye caiva vidyāṁ na tapo na dānaṁ
14.92.53d852: dr̥ṣṭamātrāt punantyete tasmāt paśyeta tān sadā.
14.92.53d853: bahūnāṁ na pradātavyā gaurvastraṁ śayanaṁ striyaḥ,
tādr̥gbhūtaṁ tu tad dānaṁ dātāraṁ nopatiṣṭhati.
14.92.53d854: mā dadātviti yo brūyād brāhmaṇeṣu ca goṣu ca,
14.92.53d855: brāhmaṇasvaṁ ca yad daivaṁ daridrasyaiva yad dhanam,
14.92.53d861: svaṁ caritraṁ ca gr̥hṇīyuḥ pr̥thivyāṁ sarvamānavāḥ.
14.92.53d863: sa jñeyo yājñiko deśo mlecchadeśastataḥ param.
14.92.53d864: śūdrastu yasmin kasmin vā nivased vr̥ttikarśitaḥ.
14.92.53d865: ācāraḥ prathamo dharmo hyahiṁsā satyameva ca,
dānaṁ caiva yathāśakti niyamāśca yamaiḥ saha.
14.92.53d866: kāryaḥ śarīrasaṁskāraḥ pāvanaḥ pretya ceha ca.
14.92.53d869: dharmārthau yadi na syātāṁ śuśrūṣā vāpi tadvidhā,
vidyā tasmin na vaktavyā śubhaṁ bījamivoṣare.
14.92.53d871: savyena savyaṁ saṅgr̥hya dakṣiṇena tu dakṣiṇam,
14.92.53d876: guroḥ parataraṁ kiñcinna bhūtaṁ na bhaviṣyati.
14.92.53d877: avamānāddhi teṣāṁ tu narakaṁ syānna saṁśayaḥ.
14.92.53d879: śapatā yat kr̥taṁ puṇyaṁ śapyamānaṁ tu gacchati,
14.92.53d880: nāstikyaṁ vedanindāṁ ca devatānāṁ ca kutsanam,
dveṣaṁ dambhaṁ ca mānaṁ ca krodhaṁ taikṣṇyaṁ vivarjayet.
14.92.53d881: kathaṁ tad brāhmaṇairdeva hotavyaṁ kṣatriyaiḥ katham,
vaiśyairvā devadeveśa kathaṁ vā suhutaṁ bhavet.
14.92.53d882: katyagnayaḥ kimātmānaḥ sthānaṁ kiṁ kasya vā vibho,
14.92.53d883: kathamevātha hūyante prīyante ca surāḥ katham.
14.92.53d884: kāṁ gatiṁ vadatāṁ śreṣṭha nayanti hyagnihotriṇaḥ.
14.92.53d886: utsannāgnistu pāpātmā kāṁ yoniṁ deva gacchati,
etat sarvaṁ samāsena bhaktyā hyupagatasya me,
14.92.53d889: yasmādagre sa bhūtānāṁ sarveṣāṁ nirmito mayā,
14.92.53d891: yasmācca tu nayatyagrāṁ gatiṁ viprān supūjitaḥ,
14.92.53d895: gr̥hāṇāṁ hi patitvaṁ hi gr̥hapatyamiti smr̥tam,
gr̥hapatyaṁ tu yasyāsīt tat tasmād gārhapatyatā.
14.92.53d896: yajamānaṁ tu yasmāt tu dakṣiṇāṁ tu gatiṁ nayet,
14.92.53d897: āhutiḥ sarvamākhyāti havyaṁ vai vahanaṁ smr̥tam,
14.92.53d898: dakṣiṇāgnistvayaṁ rudraḥ krodhātmā caṇḍa eva saḥ.
14.92.53d903: yasmād vai trāyate duḥkhād yajamānaṁ huto’nalaḥ,
14.92.53d907: vasanto brāhmaṇo jñeyo vedayoniḥ sa ucyate.
14.92.53d909: kṣatriyasyāgnirādheyo grīṣme śreṣṭhaḥ sa vai nr̥pa,
yenādhānaṁ tu vai grīṣme kriyate tasya vardhate,
śrīḥ prajāḥ paśavaścaiva vittaṁ tejo balaṁ yaśaḥ.
14.92.53d910: śaradrātraṁ svayaṁ vaiśyo vaiśyayoniḥ sa ucyate.
14.92.53d914: chandaḥ śikṣā ca kalpaśca tathā vyākaraṇāni ca,
14.92.53d922: vedyarthaṁ pr̥thivī sr̥ṣṭā sambhārārthaṁ tathaiva ca,
14.92.53d924: darbhāḥ saṁstaraṇārthaṁ tu rakṣasāṁ rakṣaṇāya ca,
14.92.53d925: śuśrūṣārthaṁ trayāṇāṁ vai śūdrāḥ sr̥ṣṭāḥ svayambhuvā.
14.92.53d927: evamiṣṭaṁ ca pūrtaṁ ca yad vipraiḥ kriyate nr̥pa,
14.92.53d928: mayā sthāpitamāditye lokasya sukr̥taṁ hi tat,
14.92.53d931: bālāhitāgnayo ye ca śūdrānnād viratāḥ sadā,
14.92.53d933: pramāṇaṁ na ca kurvanti ye yāntīhāpi durgatim.
14.92.53d934: pramāṇamitihāsaṁ ca vedān kurvanti ye dvijāḥ,
14.92.53d936: pāpino yena śuddhyanti tat te vakṣyāmi sarvaśaḥ.
14.92.53d937: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi vaiśyo vā caritavrataḥ,
yathāvat kartukāmo vai tasyaivaṁ prathamā kriyā.
14.92.53d938: śodhayet tu śarīraṁ svaṁ pañcagavyena yantritaḥ,
14.92.53d941: vāruṇaṁ caiva pañcaiva hutvā sarvān yathākramam.
14.92.53d942: viśvebhyo hi ca devebhyaḥ saprajāpataye tathā.
14.92.53d944: praṇamya cāgniṁ somaṁ ca bhasma dhr̥tvā yathāvidhi,
nadīṁ gatvā viśuddhātmā somāya varuṇāya ca,
14.92.53d947: nārāyaṇaṁ vā rudraṁ vā brahmāṇamathavāpi vā,
14.92.53d948: gāyatrīṁ mama devīṁ vā sāvitrīṁ vā japet tataḥ,
14.92.53d949: tato madhyāhnakāle vai pāyasaṁ yāvakaṁ hi vā,
14.92.53d950: pātraṁ tu susamādāya sauvarṇaṁ rājataṁ tu vā,
tāmraṁ vā mr̥ṇmayaṁ vāpi audumbaramathāpi vā.
14.92.53d951: puṭakena tu guptena cared bhaikṣaṁ samāhitaḥ.
14.92.53d952: brāhmaṇānāṁ gr̥hāṇāṁ tu saptānāṁ nāparaṁ vrajet,
14.92.53d953: na hasenna ca vīkṣeta nābhibhāṣeta vā striyam.
14.92.53d954: dr̥ṣṭvā mūtraṁ purīṣaṁ vā cāṇḍālaṁ vā rajasvalām,
14.92.53d955: ācamya vāriṇā tena vahniṁ viprāṁśca pūjayet.
14.92.53d956: pañca saptāthavā kuryād bhāgān bhaikṣasya tasya vai,
14.92.53d957: brahmaṇe cāgnaye caiva somāya varuṇāya ca,
14.92.53d959: yathā ca vardhate somo hrasate ca yathā punaḥ,
tathā piṇḍāśca vardhante hrasante ca dine dine.
14.92.53d960: brahmacārī sadā vāpi na ca vastraṁ prapīḍayet.
14.92.53d961: sthāne na divasaṁ tiṣṭhed rātrau vīrāsanaṁ vrajet,
14.92.53d962: valkalaṁ yadi vā kṣaumaṁ śāṇaṁ kārpāsakaṁ tathā,
14.92.53d963: brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā dadyāccaiva ca dakṣiṇām.
14.92.53d964: cāndrāyaṇena cīrṇena yat kr̥taṁ tena duṣkr̥tam,
14.92.53d971: kuṇḍānnaṁ golakānnaṁ ca devalānnaṁ tathaiva ca,
14.92.53d972: tailaṁ cāpi ca vikrīṇan dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṁ caret.
14.92.53d973: ekoddiṣṭaṁ tu yo bhuṅkte janamadhyagato’pi yaḥ,
14.92.53d974: yo bhuṅkte’nupanītena yo bhuṅkte ca striyā saha,
kanyayā saha yo bhuṅkte dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṁ caret.
14.92.53d975: ucchiṣṭaṁ sthāpayed vipro yo mohād bhojanāntare,
dadyād vā yadi vā mohād dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṁ caret.
14.92.53d976: chatrākaṁ laśunaṁ caiva bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṁ caret.
14.92.53d982: ekabhuktena varteta naraḥ saṁvatsaraṁ tu yaḥ,
14.92.53d986: māse māse samāpte tu bhojayitvā dvijān śucīn,
saṁvatsare tataḥ pūrṇe dadyāt tu vratadakṣiṇām.
14.92.53d987: tasya puṇyaphalaṁ rājan kathyamānaṁ mayā śr̥ṇu.
14.92.53d988: tad vinaśyati tasyāśu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.
14.92.53d989: yacca niḥśreyasaṁ loke tad bhavān vaktumarhati.
14.92.53d990: śr̥ṇu rājan mayā pūrvaṁ yathā gītaṁ tu nārade,
14.92.53d991: yastu bhaktyā śucirbhūtvā pañcamyāṁ me narādhipa,
14.92.53d992: parvadvayaṁ ca dvādaśyau śravaṇaṁ ca narādhipa,
14.92.53d995: upoṣya pūjayed yo māṁ so’śvamedhaphalaṁ labhet.
14.92.53d996: dvādaśyāṁ puṣyamāse tu nāmnā nārāyaṇaṁ tu mām,
upoṣya pūjayed yo māṁ vājimedhaphalaṁ labhet.
14.92.53d997: dvādaśyāṁ māghamāse tu māmupoṣya tu mādhavam,
14.92.53d999: dvādaśyāṁ māsi caitre tu māṁ viṣṇuṁ samupoṣya yaḥ,
14.92.53d1000: upoṣya pūjayed yo māṁ so’gniṣṭomasya pāṇḍava.
14.92.53d1001: arcayed yaḥ samāpnoti gavāṁ medhaphalaṁ nr̥pa.
14.92.53d1002: āṣāḍhe vāmanākhyaṁ māṁ dvādaśyāṁ samupoṣya yaḥ,
14.92.53d1007: yat phalaṁ pūrvamuddiṣṭaṁ tasyārdhaṁ labhate nr̥pa.
14.92.53d1009: pūrṇe saṁvatsare kuryāt punaḥ saṁvatsaraṁ tu mām.
14.92.53d1011: arcayet prītimān yo māṁ dvādaśyāṁ vedasaṁhitām,
14.92.53d1012: gandhaṁ puṣpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ patraṁ vā mūlameva vā,
dvādaśyāṁ mama yo dadyāt tatsamo nāsti matpriyaḥ.
14.92.53d1018: bhaktapriya namaste’stu kr̥ṣṇa nātha namo namaḥ.
14.92.53d1021: kr̥ṣṇa priya namaste’stu kr̥ṣṇa nātha namo namaḥ,
14.92.53d1023: gr̥hītvā keśavo haste prītātmā taṁ nyavārayat.
14.92.53d1025: anyavat kimidaṁ rājan māṁ stauṣi narapuṅgava,
14.92.53d1027: śr̥ṇu rājan yathā pūrvaṁ tat sarvaṁ kathayāmi te,
14.92.53d1029: sa gacched dakṣiṇāmūrtiṁ māṁ vā nātra vicāraṇā,
14.92.53d1032: same rātridine tatra sandhyāyāṁ viṣuve nr̥pa.
14.92.53d1035: tasmin muhūrte sarve tu cintayanti paraṁ padam.
14.92.53d1038: ete cānye ca rājendra viṣuve saṁyatendriyāḥ,
14.92.53d1039: annaṁ gāvastilān bhūmiṁ kanyādānaṁ tathaiva ca,
14.92.53d1040: yaccānyacca mayā proktaṁ tat prayaccha yudhiṣṭhira,
14.92.53d1042: candrasūryagrahe vyomni mama vā śaṅkarasya vā,
gāyatrīṁ māmikāṁ vāpi japed yaḥ śaṅkarasya vā.
14.92.53d1043: kārayet tu dhvaniṁ bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṁ śr̥ṇu.
14.92.53d1044: durbalo’pi bhaved rāhuḥ somaśca balavān bhavet.
14.92.53d1048: tāvat kālaṁ sa rājendra somaloke mahīyate.
14.92.53d1050: bhagavaṁstava gāyatrī japyate ca kathaṁ vibho,
kiṁ vā tasya phalaṁ deva mamācakṣva sureśvara.
14.92.53d1051: ayane śravaṇe caiva vyatīpāte tathaiva ca.
14.92.53d1052: japyā tu mama gāyatrī cāthavāṣṭākṣaraṁ nr̥pa,
14.92.53d1053: etat kathaya me deva paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me.
14.92.53d1054: aśvattho na sthito yatra nāhaṁ tatra pratiṣṭhitaḥ.
14.92.53d1055: yastvenamarcayed bhaktyā sa māṁ sākṣāt samarcati.
14.92.53d1056: yastvenaṁ praharet kopānmāmeva praharet tu saḥ,
14.92.53d1060: gaccha tīrthāni kaunteya dharmo dharmeṇa vardhate.
14.92.53d1064: kṣamā tu paramaṁ tīrthaṁ sarvatīrtheṣu pāṇḍava,
14.92.53d1066: kṣamā yaśaḥ kṣamā dānaṁ kṣamā yajñaḥ kṣamā damaḥ,
kṣamā hiṁsā kṣamā dharmaḥ kṣamā cendriyanigrahaḥ.
14.92.53d1067: kṣamā dayā kṣamā yajñaḥ kṣamayaiva dhr̥taṁ jagat,
kṣamāvān brāhmaṇo devaḥ kṣamāvān brāhmaṇo varaḥ.
14.92.53d1068: kṣamāvān prāpnuyānmokṣaṁ tasmāt sādhuḥ sa ucyate.
14.92.53d1074: pradakṣiṇaṁ ca yaḥ kuryāt punaraṣṭākṣareṇa tu,
14.92.53d1075: yatra kr̥ṣṭāṁ varāhasya mr̥ttikāṁ śirasā vahan,
14.92.53d1077: salilena tu yaḥ snāyāt sakr̥deva ravigrahe,
tasya yat sañcitaṁ pāpaṁ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati.
14.92.53d1078: pibet tu pañcagavyaṁ yaḥ paurṇamāsyāmupoṣya tu,
tasya naśyati tat pāpaṁ yat pāpaṁ pūrvasañcitam.
14.92.53d1079: tathaiva brahmakūrcaṁ tu samantraṁ tu pr̥thak pr̥thak,
māsi māsi pibed yastu tasya pāpaṁ praṇaśyati.
14.92.53d1080: pātraṁ ca brahmakūrcaṁ ca śr̥ṇu tatra ca bhārata,
palāśaṁ padmapatraṁ ca tāmraṁ vātha hiraṇmayam,
sādayitvā tu gr̥hṇīyāt tat tu pātramudāhr̥tam.
14.92.53d1081: āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṁ dadhi krāvṇeti vai dadhi.
14.92.53d1083: brahmaṇe ca yathā hutvā samiddhe ca hutāśane,
14.92.53d1084: uddhr̥tya praṇavenaiva pibet tu praṇavena tu,
14.92.53d1085: bhadraṁ na iti yaḥ pādaṁ paṭhan r̥k saṁhitāṁ tadā,
14.92.53d1086: mama sūktaṁ japed yastu nityaṁ madgatamānasaḥ,
14.92.53d1088: śr̥ṇu pāṇḍava tat sarvaṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ yathākramam,
saphalaṁ niṣphalaṁ caiva teṣāṁ karma bravīmi te.
14.92.53d1090: sarvāṇyetāni vai mithyā yadi bhāvo na nirmalaḥ.
14.92.53d1091: tamagryaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ manye śeṣāḥ śūdrā iti smr̥tāḥ.
14.92.53d1093: na jātyā pūjito rājan guṇāḥ kalyāṇakāraṇāḥ,
14.92.53d1094: hr̥dayasya ca śaucena svargaṁ gacchanti mānavāḥ.
14.92.53d1096: vikarmasevī kaunteya sa vai vr̥ṣala ucyate.
14.92.53d1097: vr̥ṣo hi dharmo vijñeyastasya yaḥ kurute layam,
14.92.53d1098: na tu māṁ stauti pāpātmā sa tu caṇḍālataḥ samaḥ.
14.92.53d1099: śvadr̥tau tu yathā kṣīraṁ brahma vai vr̥ṣale tathā,
duṣṭatāmeti tat sarvaṁ śunā līḍhaṁ haviryathā.
14.92.53d1102: tasmāt tāni na śūdrasya spr̥ṣṭavyāni yudhiṣṭhira,
14.92.53d1108: ūrdhvāmeva gatiṁ viddhi kiṁ punarjñānināṁ nr̥ṇām.
14.92.53d1109: patraṁ vāpyathavā puṣpaṁ phalaṁ vāpyapa eva vā,
dadāti mama śūdro yacchirasā dhārayāmi tat.
14.92.53d1110: māmarcayanti ye viprā matsāyujyaṁ vrajanti te.
14.92.53d1113: mr̥dā ca maṇiratnaiśca tāmreṇa rajatena ca,
14.92.53d1124: tapastīrthaṁ dayā tīrthaṁ śīlaṁ tīrthaṁ yudhiṣṭhira,
14.92.53d1127: na divā yadi vā rātrāvudvegaḥ śūdralaṅghanāt.
14.92.53d1128: na bhayaṁ devadaityebhyo rakṣobhyaścaiva me nr̥pa,
śūdravaktrāccyutaṁ brahma bhayaṁ tu mama sarvadā.
14.92.53d1129: tasmāt sapraṇavaṁ śūdro mannāmāpi na kīrtayet,
praṇavaṁ hi paraṁ loke brahma brahmavido viduḥ.
14.92.53d1132: patraṁ puṣpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati,
14.92.53d1133: yadi māṁ satataṁ dhyāyet sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate.
14.92.53d1134: mayi bhaktiṁ na kurvanti cāṇḍālasadr̥śā hi te.
14.92.53d1135: vr̥thā dānaṁ vr̥thā taptaṁ vr̥thā ceṣṭaṁ vr̥thā hutam,
vr̥thā’’tibhyaṁ ca tat tasya yo na bhakto mama dvijaḥ.
14.92.53d1139: kiṁ punarye yajante māṁ sadāraṁ vidhipūrvakam,
14.92.53d1141: avāpsyasi tataḥ siddhiṁ drakṣyatyeva paraṁ padam.
14.92.53d1143: stuvanti satataṁ ye māṁ te vai bhāgavatāḥ smr̥tāḥ.
14.92.53d1146: mamāśrayo na kaścit tu sarveṣāmāśrayo hyaham.
14.92.53d1151: śrāvayed yastvidaṁ bhaktyā prayato’tha śr̥ṇoti vā,
sa gacchenmama sāyujyaṁ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.
14.92.53d1157: śrutvā tu paramaṁ puṇyaṁ vaiṣṇavaṁ dharmaśāsanam.
14.92.53d1158: praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuṁ pratinandya ca tāḥ kathāḥ.
14.92.53d1159: draṣṭāro dvārakāyāṁ vai vayaṁ sarve jagadgurum,
sarve r̥ṣigaṇā rājan yayuḥ svaṁ svaṁ niveśanam.
14.92.53d1160: gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu keśavaḥ keśihā hariḥ,
sasmāra dārukaṁ rājan sa ca sātyakinā saha,
14.92.53d1162: dhr̥tarāṣṭraṁ ca gāndhārīṁ viduraṁ draupadīṁ tathā.
14.92.53d1170: pr̥ṣṭhato’nuyayuḥ kr̥ṣṇaṁ mā śabda iti harṣitāḥ.
14.92.53d1171: triyojane vyatīte tu pariṣvajya ca pāṇḍavān,
visr̥jya kr̥ṣṇastān sarvān praṇatān dvārakāṁ yayau.
14.92.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhike parvaṇi anugītāparvaṇi nakulopākhyāne dvinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥92॥
